description:
Experienced Solar Lead Generation & Appointment Setter — NJ / PA / NY



I am looking for an experienced solar lead generation specialist who has PROVEN experience generating qualified residential homeowner leads and booked solar appointments in:



???????? New Jersey

???????? Pennsylvania

???????? New York



THIS IS NOT A BASIC VA POSITION



I am specifically looking for someone who has already worked with solar companies, solar sales organizations, roofing companies, HVAC, or other residential home-service businesses and understands how to generate homeowners through online marketing.



What I need you to do



You will be responsible for helping generate and book:



• Qualified residential homeowners

• Exclusive solar appointments

• Homeowners who actually own the property

• Homeowners with qualifying electric usage/bills

• Homeowners interested in speaking with a solar representative

• Appointments confirmed with the homeowner

• Appointments scheduled directly on my calendar



Marketing experience required



You should have experience with some or all of:



•
/Instagram Ads

• Google Ads

• Lead-generation campaigns

• Landing pages

• Lead funnels

• Retargeting

• SMS/email follow-up

• Appointment setting

• CRM systems

• Homeowner targeting

• Solar lead generation



Additional offer



We can also market $0-upfront solar options and, for qualified homeowners, potential roof repair/roofing and tree-removal assistance.



I want someone who can use these offers strategically to generate homeowners who are genuinely interested—not people simply submitting forms for free services.



VERY IMPORTANT



I do NOT want:



❌ Scraped lists

❌ Purchased homeowner lists

❌ Random phone numbers

❌ Aged leads

❌ Shared leads

❌ Fake leads

❌ Unqualified leads



I want real homeowners who have been properly qualified and are willing to speak with me.



When you apply, answer these questions:



1. How many years have you generated leads?

2. Have you generated solar leads specifically?

3. Which NJ, PA or NY markets have you generated leads in?

4. What advertising platforms have you personally managed?

5. How did you generate the homeowners?

6. What was your average cost per qualified lead?

7. What was your average cost per booked appointment?

8. What was your appointment show rate?

9. Can you provide examples, screenshots, case studies or references showing your results?

10. What would your strategy be for generating qualified NJ/PA/NY solar appointments?



Trial



I am willing to start with a small paid trial for someone who can demonstrate real experience and results.



If you can consistently generate qualified homeowners and booked appointments, there is potential for long-term work and increased compensation based on performance.



IMPORTANT: In your application, start your message with “SOLAR NJ PA NY” so I know you read the entire posting.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).

+$500 when $10,000 is reached

title: Global Supply Chain & Operations Lead
description:
Global Supply Chain & Operations Lead



Focus: Demand Planning, Fulfillment & Regional Compliance



About the Role



We're looking for the architect of our global hardware fulfillment operation. You'll ensure our resellers across LATAM, North America, and EMEA never experience a stockout, that our hardware compliance (NOM, ANATEL, CE) stays ahead of our sales expansion, and that our purchasing strategy balances margin against lead-time risk. This is not a coordination role — you will own the physical supply chain end to end.



Key Responsibilities



Global Demand Planning

Transform historical sales data into a rolling 6–12 month forecast. Determine what we order, when, and from which origin (China vs. Houston) to optimize for both cost and speed.



Country Coordination & Compliance

Lead market-entry operations for new countries — mapping required certifications, import hurdles, tax/duty implications, and local SIM/data provider sourcing.



Vendor Management

Own the relationship with our primary hardware partners (e.g., Streamax), including negotiating reorder points, buffer stock requirements, and SLA compliance.



Process Automation

Maintain our Fulfillment Live Tracker and use AI and low-code tools (Zapier/Make) to build workflows that flag backorder risk before it becomes a customer-facing issue.



What Success Looks Like

Operational Rigor — You act on data, not just report it. If a SKU shows 20 days of supply against a 40-day lead time, the purchase order is already being drafted before it comes up in a meeting.



Global Fluency — You understand that logistics in Brazil are not the same as logistics in Canada, and you navigate tradeoffs like China drop-ship margin vs. local warehouse speed instinctively.



Builder Mindset — You treat manual processes as a problem to solve. You use AI to automate reporting, status updates, and vendor communications so you can focus on strategy.



Requirements

Proven experience in demand planning, inventory forecasting, or supply chain management, ideally in hardware/physical goods

Experience navigating multi-country compliance, customs, and import/export regulations

Comfort with vendor negotiation and SLA management

Practical experience using AI tools and/or low-code automation platforms (Zapier, Make, or similar) to streamline operational workflows

Strong async communication skills and ability to work across time zones

Spanish or Portuguese fluency is a strong plus, given our LATAM focus

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field preferred



To Apply



Reading Check

Put the keyword MANIFEST in your subject line — this tells us you actually read the post, not just the title.



1. This post names two low-code tools we use to flag backorder risk before it becomes a customer issue. What are they?

2. Under "What Success Looks Like," what should already be happening to a SKU showing 20 days of supply against a 40-day lead time, before it ever comes up in a meeting?



Questions

3. Walk us through a real demand-forecasting or reorder-point model you've built or owned — what data fed it, and what decision it drove.

4. Describe a time a country-specific compliance, customs, or import requirement could have caused a stockout or delay if you'd missed it. What did you do?

5. What's the toughest vendor negotiation or SLA tradeoff you've had to manage (cost vs. speed vs. quality)?

6. Which time zones can you comfortably cover, given this role spans LATAM, North America, and EMEA?

7. Desired hourly rate (USD) and earliest start date?



AI/Automation Loom (required)

Record a Loom, max 8 minutes, walking through one real workflow you've built or improved using AI (Claude or similar) or a low-code tool like Zapier or Make, ideally in demand planning, vendor communication, compliance tracking, or reporting. Show the actual before and after, not just a description.



If you haven't built something like this yet, use the Loom instead to open Claude or ChatGPT live and think out loud through how you'd turn a manual process, like flagging SKUs at risk of stockout, into an automated check. We're evaluating how you think and use the tool, not polish.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Exterior Construction Company

We are a growing exterior construction company looking for a highly organized, reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support our daily operations.



This is a long-term position for someone who is dependable, professional, comfortable communicating with homeowners and customers, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities without constant supervision.



The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can stay organized, follow through on tasks, and help keep our operations running smoothly.



Responsibilities

Answer and manage inbound customer and homeowner calls professionally.

Respond to customer inquiries and provide accurate information.

Schedule appointments, inspections, estimates, and other service-related activities.

Register and manage roofing warranties and ensure documentation is complete.

Organize and maintain customer, project, and warranty records.

Prepare, submit, and follow up on permits when required.

Coordinate information between homeowners, office staff, contractors, and project teams.

Manage daily administrative tasks and follow up on outstanding items.

Maintain organized digital files, documents, spreadsheets, and records.

Enter and update customer and project information accurately.

Monitor schedules, deadlines, and important follow-ups.

Assist with general office and administrative tasks as needed.

Identify issues or missing information and take initiative to resolve them.

Help improve administrative processes and keep daily operations organized.

Requirements

Previous experience as an Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Customer Service Representative, or similar role.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Professional and confident communication skills.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Excellent attention to detail.

Comfortable handling inbound phone calls.

Able to manage multiple responsibilities and priorities.

Reliable, dependable, and consistent.

Proactive and able to work independently.

Comfortable using computers,
, spreadsheets, and online systems.

Fast learner who can quickly learn new software and processes.

Experience with construction, roofing, home services, permits, or warranties is a strong plus.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work.



You should be the type of person who keeps track of tasks, follows up without being reminded, notices when something is missing, and makes sure responsibilities are completed correctly and on time.



You will be handling important communication with homeowners and helping coordinate administrative processes, so professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail are extremely important.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person. We want someone who can grow with our company and become a trusted part of our team.



How to Apply

Please provide:



Your resume or work history.

A brief introduction about yourself.

Your previous administrative or customer service experience.

Your experience handling inbound calls.

Your experience with scheduling, permits, warranties, or construction administration, if applicable.

The software and tools you are comfortable using.

Your availability and expected hourly rate.

Application Test: Please explain briefly how you would organize and prioritize 10 different administrative tasks that all need attention on the same day. This will help us understand your organizational and problem-solving skills.

title: Conversion Copywriter + Conversion Rate Optimization CRO / Offer Strategist for Financial SaaS Product
description:
I'm the founder of GoldSignal.ai, a financial research and data platform focused primarily on gold and silver stocks.



I'm looking for someone with strong experience in marketing, conversion optimization, landing pages, SaaS offers, subscription products, or direct-response copywriting to help me improve how the paid GoldSignal product is positioned and sold. You do not need to code the page. Strong marketing judgment, copywriting, customer psychology, and conversion thinking are more important.



This is a one-time specialist project, not a traditional VA position. 



The main goal is simple: when a serious investor lands on the GoldSignal Pro page, they should quickly understand:

- What they get

- Why it is valuable

- Why it is different from information they can find for free

- Why the subscription is worth paying for

- What makes GoldSignal credible

- What action they should take next



GoldSignal includes research and data around insider buying, major ownership stakes, investor portfolios, strategic accumulation, public filings, quantitative signals, alerts, research reports, and a curated set of investable ideas for paid members.



I want help improving:

- Product positioning

- Offer structure

- Value proposition

- Above-the-fold messaging

- Headlines and copy

- Pricing presentation

- Feature/value hierarchy

- Calls to action

- Trust and credibility

- Objection handling

- Overall conversion flow

- How the highest-value parts of the paid product are presented



Important: I do NOT want an aggressive or hype-driven investment sales page. GoldSignal should still feel like a serious, modern financial data and research platform. Think high-quality SaaS / financial intelligence product, not a "get rich quick" stock newsletter.



I already have the product, website, research, data, pricing, and general brand direction. I need someone who can step back, understand the customer and the offer, and organize the page so the value is immediately clear and compelling.



Ideal deliverables:

1. Audit of the current paid landing page

2. Identification of the biggest conversion problems

3. Recommended positioning and offer structure

4. Rewritten landing-page copy

5. Recommended page hierarchy

6. Pricing and value-presentation recommendations

7. Suggestions for trust, proof, objections, and calls to action

8. A wireframe, annotated mockup, or clear visual guidance that can be handed to a developer / AI coding workflow



You do not need to code the page. Strong marketing judgment, copywriting, customer psychology, and conversion thinking are more important.



Experience with SaaS, financial products, subscription businesses, newsletters, investing products, CRO, landing pages, or direct-response marketing is a major plus.



When applying, please include:

- 2-5 examples of landing pages, SaaS products, sales pages, pricing pages, or offers you have personally worked on, with a short description of your role on each

- Your hourly rate or proposed project rate

- Short answers to these questions:

   1. What are the first three things you would examine when trying to improve the conversion rate of a paid subscription landing page?

   2. GoldSignal is a serious financial-data product. How would you make an investment offer more compelling without making it sound hype-driven or promotional?

   3. Are you comfortable reviewing an existing product and recommending changes to positioning, offer structure, copy, pricing presentation, and page hierarchy rather than simply redesigning the visuals?



Please do not send a long generic AI-generated cover letter. I am much more interested in your thinking, judgment, and examples of real work.

————————————————————

**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.

For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————

**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.

**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Sales Operations & CRM Coordinator – GoHighLevel
description:
Infinity Electrical & Solar is an established electrical, solar and battery company based in Perth, Western Australia.

We are looking for a highly organised Sales Operations & CRM Coordinator to join our team remotely from the Philippines.

This is not a sales position and is not simply a data-entry VA role.

Your responsibility will be to ensure our sales CRM is accurate, our salespeople are following up their opportunities, management has clear visibility of sales performance, and no customer leads are being forgotten.

Key responsibilities

You will be responsible for managing and maintaining our GoHighLevel CRM, including:

Monitoring all new sales leads

Ensuring leads are allocated to the correct salesperson

Checking that new leads are contacted promptly

Monitoring overdue salesperson follow-ups

Identifying leads that haven't received sufficient follow-up

Maintaining accurate pipeline stages

Ensuring opportunities contain correct customer and sales information

Cleaning duplicate and incomplete CRM records

Monitoring quotes sent by each salesperson

Tracking Won and Lost opportunities

Recording reasons opportunities were lost

Maintaining accurate solar system kW and battery kWh data

Tracking additional products sold

Preparing daily salesperson KPI reports

Preparing weekly sales performance reports

Maintaining monthly sales and commission data

Building lists of older leads for salespeople to reactivate

Identifying problems or bottlenecks within our sales pipeline

You will work closely with our Managing Director, administration team and salespeople.

Daily sales reporting

One of your most important responsibilities will be preparing management information before our 8:30am daily sales meeting.

For each salesperson we want visibility of:

New leads received | Leads contacted | Outstanding leads | Calls | Follow-ups | Overdue follow-ups | Quotes sent | Sales won | Conversion rate | Solar kW sold | Battery kWh sold | Monthly target progress

You will be expected to identify problems rather than simply enter information.

For example:

“Salesperson A has 8 new leads that haven't been contacted, 13 overdue follow-ups and 4 quotes that haven't been followed up.”

Management should be able to open the CRM every morning and immediately understand the health of the sales pipeline.

Who we're looking for

You should have:

Excellent written and spoken English

Previous CRM experience

GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred

Excellent attention to detail

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Experience preparing reports

Experience working with sales teams

Confidence communicating with salespeople and management

Ability to work independently

Strong organisational skills

Reliable computer and internet connection

Experience building GoHighLevel workflows, dashboards, automations and reporting would be highly regarded.

Previous experience working for an Australian company is also advantageous.

Working hours

Monday–Friday

7:30am–4:00pm Perth, Western Australia time

You must be available during these hours because you'll be working directly with our Australian team.

Salary

A$1,500–A$2,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated GoHighLevel capability.

There is opportunity for the position and remuneration to grow as you take greater responsibility for our sales operations.

How to apply

Please include the following in your application:

A short introduction about yourself.

Your previous CRM experience.

Your experience specifically with GoHighLevel.

An example of a sales report or dashboard you've previously maintained or created.

Your expected monthly salary.

Confirmation that you can work 7:30am–4:00pm Perth time Monday–Friday.

A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be suitable for the position.

Please start your application with the words:

“INFINITY CRM”

Applications that don't include this will not be considered.

description:
Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator — E-Commerce (European Marketplaces)



About Us

We are a fast-growing European e-commerce business selling furniture and home décor across 10+ marketplaces including Vente-Unique, Kaufland, 
, Cdiscount, Allegro, and others across France, Germany, Belgium, Netherlands, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Austria, Poland, and Luxembourg. We source products from factories in China and ship directly to fulfillment warehouses in Europe. We are expanding aggressively — new SKUs, new marketplaces, and more containers every quarter.



The Role

We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator to own our end-to-end supply chain operations — from inventory planning and purchase orders through to container booking, customs documentation, inbound warehouse coordination, and ongoing fulfillment center management.



This is a long-term position with growing responsibility. As we expand our product range and marketplace presence, the workload and scope of this role will grow significantly. We are looking for someone who wants to build something with us, not just complete tasks.



**You are paid per hour worked — no fixed hours, no idle time pay. You log hours when actively working.**



---



Your Responsibilities



Inventory Planning & Procurement

- Monitor stock levels per SKU across all marketplaces

- Calculate days of stock remaining and flag reorder points before stockout

- Prepare and send purchase orders to the factory

- Track container deposits and payment schedules

- Maintain a clear overview of all open orders and incoming stock



Shipment Coordination

- Book containers with the shipping agent

- Review and verify bill of lading, packing list, and commercial invoice

- Verify HS codes on all shipment documents for customs clearance

- Communicate invoices and documentation to the freight forwarder for import customs clearance

- Track container ETAs and update internal records



Inbound Logistics

- Book unloading slots on Shiptify approximately 4-6 weeks before container arrival

- Monitor ETAs vs booked slots — proactively rebook and replan when delays occur

- Communicate with the fulfillment warehouse to coordinate arrival and inbound processing

- Coordinate with the freight forwarder for final delivery to the warehouse

- Create inbound shipments in our WMS (Hubble) ahead of container arrival



Fulfillment Center Management

- Manage ongoing communication with the fulfillment center through their ticketing system

- Attend monthly performance calls with the fulfillment center to review issues and improvements

title: Head of Operations - Short-Term Rental Property Management (Remote, EU Hours)
description:
HEAD OF OPERATIONS - SHORT-TERM RENTAL PROPERTY MANAGEMENT



Remote - Philippines

Full-Time - European Hours

Long-Term Growth Opportunity



ABOUT LANDO PARIS



Lando Paris is an established short-term rental and property management company managing a growing portfolio of apartments in Paris and the surrounding area.



We coordinate guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance, property owners, Airbnb listings, emergencies, onboarding, quality control and business development.



We are now looking for a highly capable Head of Operations who can progressively take full ownership of the company’s daily operations.



This is not a basic Virtual Assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can think, organize, make decisions, improve systems, create clear SOPs, manage people and eventually run the entire operational side of the company with minimal involvement from the founder.



YOUR MAIN OBJECTIVE



Your objective will be to make Lando operate smoothly, professionally and independently without the founder being involved in daily operations.



You will initially handle many tasks yourself. As the portfolio grows, you will recruit, train and manage additional Virtual Assistants and specialists.



You will be responsible for the system, even when individual tasks are later delegated to other team members.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily operations:



* Manage guest messages across Airbnb and other communication channels

* Coordinate housekeepers and confirm every cleaning

* Coordinate maintenance workers and local service providers

* Manage check-in, check-out and access issues

* Handle guest complaints, emergencies and service recovery

* Track every i
 until it is completely resolved

* Request and verify photos after cleaning or maintenance

* Maintain accurate property information, instructions and checklists

* Make sure no task, arrival, issue or owner request is forgotten



Property and owner management:



* Communicate professionally with property owners by
 and messaging

* Collect missing property information, documents, photos and equipment details

* Coordinate new property onboarding

* Create and update Airbnb listings

* Keep property accounts, calendars and settings accurate

* Organize photographers, maintenance, supplies and property improvements

* Prepare clear updates and reports for owners

* Identify risks before they become complaints



Systems and process improvement:



* Document all recurring processes as clear SOPs

* Build checklists, decision trees and escalation procedures

* Audit our current processes and recommend improvements

* Automate repetitive tasks using AI, Make, Zapier or similar tools

* Organize tasks and information using Google Workspace and project management software

* Create weekly operational dashboards

* Maintain a structured database of properties, owners and service providers

* Continuously look for ways to improve quality, speed and efficiency



Team management:



* Help recruit future Guest Communication VAs and operational assistants

* Train new team members using SOPs and recorded processes

* Review their work and provide feedback

* Build schedules and backup coverage

* Monitor performance and accountability

* Make sure the team maintains Lando’s service standards



Lead management:



* Make sure every new lead from Airbnb or our website enters the CRM

* Collect and organize the information needed by the French-speaking salesperson

* Assign leads immediately and notify the salesperson

* Monitor response times and follow-up status

* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline



You will not be responsible for closing French sales calls. A French-speaking salesperson will handle them.



LANGUAGE AND COMMUNICATION



Excellent written and spoken English is required.



French is not required.



Most French communication will be completed using AI translation, approved templates and clear internal guidelines. French voice messages can be transcribed and translated using AI.



You must be extremely careful when checking:



* Names

* Dates and times

* Addresses

* Prices and refunds

* Instructions

* Promises made to guests or owners



We expect you to use AI intelligently, but never send unverified AI output.



French phone calls will be handled separately.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have at least three years of experience in operations, project management, property management or hospitality

* Ideally have previous Airbnb or short-term rental experience

* Have coordinated guests, housekeepers, maintenance workers or vendors

* Have created SOPs, checklists or operational systems

* Have managed or trained other team members

* Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

* Learn new software quickly

* Are comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools

* Can solve problems without waiting for constant instructions

* Take responsibility when something goes wrong

* Communicate clearly and professionally

* Know when to make a decision and when to escalate

* Have a reliable computer, Internet connection and backup Internet

* Are looking for a serious, long-term position



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* Airbnb

* Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable or another PMS

* Google Workspace

* GoHighLevel

* ClickUp, Asana or Notion

* Make or Zapier

* ChatGPT or Claude

* WhatsApp Business

* Short-term rental operations



HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO ESCALATE PROBLEMS



We do not want messages that simply say:



“What should I do?”



Before escalating, you should provide:



1. What happened

2. The potential impact

3. What you already checked

4. The possible solutions

5. Your recommended solution

6. The deadline for making the decision



Critical safety, security, legal or access issues must always be escalated immediately.



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position of approximately 40 hours per week.



Your regular schedule must overlap with Paris business and guest-arrival hours. A likely schedule would be approximately 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time, adjusted when European daylight-saving time changes.



The agreed schedule may include one weekend day.



The company serves guests seven days per week. You will own the coverage system, but you will not be expected to personally work 13 hours per day, seven days per week.



During the initial transition, occasional critical monitoring outside core hours may be required. AI, automation and backup coverage will progressively handle the remaining periods.



COMPENSATION AND PROGRESSION



Starting compensation:



USD $500 per month during the initial 90-day probationary and training period.



After successfully completing the 90-day scorecard:



USD $1,000 per month.



There is a path to USD $1,800 or more as:



* The portfolio grows

* You take full ownership of operations

* The founder is removed from daily operations

* You successfully recruit and manage additional VAs

* You consistently improve service quality and efficiency



Performance bonuses may also be introduced based on operational quality, reliability, process improvements and company performance.



FIRST 90-DAY OUTCOMES



By the end of your first 90 days, we expect:



* Daily operations to run without constant founder involvement

* Every recurring task to be documented and tracked

* Cleaning, maintenance and arrival workflows to be reliable

* A structured SOP library to be established

* A weekly operational dashboard to be delivered

* New leads to be routed and tracked correctly

* Escalations to include research, options and recommendations

* The founder’s operational involvement to be reduced to fewer than four hours per week

* Guest and owner service quality to remain consistently high



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words:



BONJOUR LANDO



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years of operations, property management or short-term rental experience do you have?

2. How many properties or client accounts have you managed at the same time?

3. Describe the most difficult operational i
 you personally handled. What happened and what did you do?

4. Describe one SOP, system or automation you created. What problem did it solve?

5. Which project management, property management and AI tools have you used?

6. Have you ever recruited, trained or managed other team members?

7. Are you available to work European hours, including one weekend day?

8. What backup Internet or power solution do you have?

9. Why are you interested in taking ownership of an entire operation rather than working as a task-based VA?



Please include your CV and any relevant examples of SOPs, dashboards or systems you have previously created.



You may use AI to help structure your application, but every claim must be truthful and based on your real experience.



Generic cover letters will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical operations test and a final video interview.

California solar permitting

Inspections and AHJ coordination

Meter spots and utility coordination

Interconnection applications and PTO

Solar financing processes

Managing projects from permitting through installation, inspection, and PTO

Professional phone and
 communication

Managing multiple active projects and deadlines

title: Finance Operations Lead / Controller — Global Finance, AI & Automation
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced, highly reliable Finance Operations Lead / Controller to help own and continuously improve the finance function across a growing global business.



This is not a traditional bookkeeping role, and it is not a strategic CFO role.



CPA  license preferred



We need someone who can operate in the middle:



Understand the complete financial cycle

Ensure the numbers are reliable

Review and guide the work of finance administrators/bookkeepers

Identify risks before management has to ask

Improve processes and controls

Support finance operations across multiple countries and entities

Use AI, automation and lightweight internal tools to make the finance organization more accurate, scalable and efficient

The most important qualities for this role are reliability, trust, maturity, ownership and financial judgment.



We are looking for someone who can be trusted to look after the finance operation, recognize when something does not make sense, ask the right questions and follow issues through to resolution.



AI and automation experience is important, but it does not replace strong finance fundamentals.



What You Will Own

Financial Operations & Control

You will help oversee the complete finance operating cycle, including:



Month-end close and financial reporting

P&L and balance-sheet review

Bank and balance-sheet reconciliations

Accounts receivable

Accounts payable

Billing

Cash management

Working-capital monitoring

13-week cash-flow forecasting

Journal-entry review

Accruals and prepayments

Budgeting and budget-versus-actual analysis

Financial controls

Management reporting

Audit and year-end support

Coordination with external accountants, tax specialists and other advisors

You should be comfortable looking across the entire financial operation rather than being specialized only in AP, AR, tax or another individual area.



Global Finance Operations

Our business operates across multiple markets.



You do not need to personally be an expert in every country's tax, legal or accounting rules.



You do need enough financial maturity and experience to recognize when something may create a:



Tax issue

Compliance issue

Accounting issue

Cross-border issue

Cash-flow risk

Control weakness

Reporting issue

You should be comfortable saying:



“I don't yet have enough information to approve this. Here are the questions we need answered, here is the risk I see, and here is where we may need specialist advice.”



We value that judgment much more than someone pretending to know every answer.



Leadership & Ownership

You will help supervise and develop finance administrators and bookkeepers.



This includes:



Reviewing their work

Establishing clear procedures

Creating appropriate controls

Identifying recurring mistakes

Coaching team members

Improving documentation

Assigning ownership clearly

Ensuring important activities are completed without management repeatedly following up

We are looking for someone who naturally takes responsibility for the outcome, not simply completion of a task.



If something looks wrong, you investigate it.



If something is unclear, you ask.



If a process repeatedly fails, you improve the process.



If management has missed a risk, you raise it.



AI, Automation & Finance Systems

A major part of this role is helping us build a more modern finance operation.



We want someone who is already experimenting with or actively using tools such as:



Claude

Claude Projects

Claude Code

ChatGPT or similar AI tools

AI-assisted coding tools

Automation platforms

APIs

Advanced spreadsheets

Scripts

No-code / low-code tools

Finance system integrations

You do not need to be a professional software engineer.



You should, however, be comfortable using technology and AI to solve operational problems.



Examples of what we want to build

You may help create:



Scheduled financial analyses

Automated daily or weekly finance reviews

Exception-based reconciliation workflows

AR aging analysis and collection prioritization

Automated billing checks

Cash-flow monitoring

Budget-versus-actual analysis

Expense anomaly detection

Month-end close checklists

Balance-sheet account review workflows

Scheduled audit and control checks

Management reporting

AI-assisted investigation of unusual transactions

Finance knowledge bases

SOP and policy assistants

Internal finance dashboards

Workflow tools for finance administrators

The objective is not to automate financial judgment away.



The objective is to automate repetitive work and make exceptions, risks and decisions easier for experienced humans to identify.



How We Think About AI

We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:



What can safely be automated



and



What still requires human judgment, review and approval.



For example, AI may help:



Analyze transactions

Compare reports

Identify anomalies

Prepare summaries

Investigate supporting information

Draft communications

Prioritize exceptions

But important accounting decisions, financial controls and money movement still require appropriate human review.



You should naturally think about:



Accuracy

Auditability

Controls

Data security

Approval workflows

Human verification

Documentation

when designing AI-enabled finance processes.



What We Care About Most

1. Reliability

If you say something will be done, it gets done.



Management should not have to repeatedly follow up.



2. Trust & Integrity

You will have visibility into highly sensitive financial information.



We need someone with mature judgment and a strong sense of professional responsibility.



3. Financial Judgment

You notice when the numbers don't make sense.



You know what questions to ask.



You understand that a report being generated successfully does not mean the report is correct.



4. Ownership

You follow problems through to resolution instead of simply handing them to someone else.



5. Critical Thinking

You challenge assumptions respectfully and are comfortable telling management when you believe something requires further investigation.



6. Curiosity & Learning

You actively learn new systems, technologies and ways of working.



7. Process Improvement

You naturally look at repetitive or error-prone processes and ask:



“Can we design this better?”



Experience We Are Looking For

Ideally you have:



7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience

Experience as a Financial Controller, Assistant Controller, Accounting Manager, Finance Manager, Finance Operations Lead or similar

Experience owning or substantially managing month-end close

Strong understanding of financial statements

Strong balance-sheet reconciliation experience

Cash-flow forecasting experience

AP and AR oversight

Budgeting and variance analysis

Experience reviewing other people's accounting work

Experience managing or mentoring finance staff

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Experience with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or similar accounting systems

Strong professional English

Experience working with North American or international businesses

Experience supporting multiple entities, countries or currencies is strongly preferred.



CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent credentials are valuable but not mandatory if you have exceptional practical experience.



Regional & Multi-Entity Experience

Experience maintaining or reconciling a chart of accounts across multiple entities or countries, and working knowledge of regional compliance requirements (tax filings, statutory reporting, or coordinating with local accounting/tax advisors across jurisdictions), is a strong plus.



Banking, Financing & Growth Experience (a plus, not required)

We would love to hear from candidates who have helped a growing business move up a stage of financial maturity — for example, building the reporting and controls that supported a bank facility or lender relationship, running cash-flow forecasts used for financing decisions, supporting an investor or due-diligence process, or helping a company expand into new entities or countries. We are not looking for someone whose main claim is a large institutional fundraise. We are looking for real, demonstrated progression — something like: "When the company was $15M, I helped build the financial reporting, improved working capital, prepared the bank package, helped secure a facility, and built the systems that supported the company as it grew to $40M."



Backgrounds We're Especially Interested In

SaaS / software / technology; IoT / telecom; technology-enabled services; logistics, fleet or transportation; PE-backed growth businesses; startups or scale-ups that became meaningful businesses; multi-entity entrepreneurial companies; subscription or recurring-revenue businesses; and businesses that combine hardware with recurring software or services. Big Four experience is a great foundation, but we're most interested in people who went on to operate inside a business afterward.



AI / Automation Experience

We would particularly like to meet candidates who can demonstrate something they have actually built.



Examples include:



A Claude Project used as a finance knowledge or analysis system

An automated monthly reporting process

A recurring financial audit/checking workflow

A reconciliation tool

An AI-assisted AR or collections process

A financial dashboard

A workflow connecting several systems

An automated variance-analysis process

An internal finance tool built using AI-assisted coding

A process that substantially reduced manual finance work

Simply saying “I use ChatGPT” is not what we are looking for.



We want to understand:



What problem did you identify?



What did you build?



How did it work?



What controls did you put around it?



What changed as a result?



Location & Schedule

We are particularly interested in candidates based in LATAM because strong overlap with the Toronto / Eastern North American workday is important.



Candidates elsewhere may still be considered if they can provide substantial working-hour overlap.



Compensation

depending on experience, demonstrated financial judgment, leadership capability and ability to improve systems.



We may also consider beginning with an experienced candidate on a part-time or trial basis.



Hiring Process

We intend to move quickly, but we will evaluate this position carefully.



The process will include:



Application review

Short screening interview

Financial judgment interview

Paid practical assessment

Final discussion

Reference checks

Practical Assessment

Finalists will receive a fictional company's financial and operational information, which may include:



P&L

Balance sheet

General ledger

Bank reconciliations

AP aging

AR aging

Payroll information

Budget

Cash-flow forecast

Prior-period results

You will be asked to identify:



Problems

Risks

Unusual trends

Missing information

Questions you would ask

What you would investigate

What you would require before approving the financial reporting

There will also be a process-improvement / AI exercise.



We may provide a manual finance workflow and ask you to explain how you would redesign it using better processes, automation and AI.



We care about how you think, not simply whether you find every planted accounting error.



To Apply

Put the keyword LEDGER in your subject line.



Before question 1, answer this reading check in your own words (the answers are in this post — this is how we know you actually read it):



a. Where are we especially interested in candidates being based, and why?

b. Name two of the AI tools or platforms we mention in this post that we'd like you to already be experimenting with.



Then please answer the following questions.



1. Finance Ownership

What is the most significant finance operation you have personally owned or managed?



Please explain your responsibilities, company size and team size.



2. Financial Judgment

Tell us about a financial number, report or assumption that looked reasonable but that you challenged.



What made you question it, and what did you discover?



3. Reliability

Tell us about a finance process or responsibility where other people depended on you every week or every month.



How did you make sure it was completed accurately and on time?



4. Month-End

A bookkeeper tells you that the month is closed.



What do you personally review before telling the CEO that the financial statements are reliable?



5. Cash Flow

What are the most important judgment-based assumptions in a 13-week cash-flow forecast?



6. Global Operations

Tell us about your experience supporting companies operating across multiple countries, entities or currencies.



7. AI / Automation

Describe one finance process that you personally automated or substantially redesigned.



What existed before?



What did you build?



Which tools did you use?



What changed afterward?



8. AI Tools

What have you built using Claude, Claude Projects, Claude Code, ChatGPT, AI coding tools, APIs, scripts, Zapier/Make or similar technologies?



Please be specific.



9. Controls

What finance activities would you not fully automate using AI, and why?



10. Process Design

Imagine five finance administrators spend several hours every Monday manually collecting reports, updating spreadsheets, reviewing customer balances and identifying issues.



How would you approach improving that process?



11. Management Challenge

Tell us about a time you disagreed with a CEO, CFO or senior manager about a financial issue.



What did you do?



12. Practical Details

Please provide:



Current location

Current working hours/time zone

Desired monthly compensation in USD

Earliest available start date

LinkedIn profile, if available

Any examples, screenshots or descriptions of finance tools or automations you have built



13. AI/Automation Loom (required)

Record a short Loom (max 8 minutes) walking through one real finance automation, tool or process you personally built for a team — not a generic tour of an AI tool. Show the before, the actual build (a script, a Claude/ChatGPT workflow, a Zapier/Make chain, a spreadsheet system, whatever it was), the controls you put around it, and what changed as a result. If you honestly have not built anything like this yet, say so plainly in one line, and instead walk through, live and thinking out loud, how you personally would use Claude to redesign the Monday-morning manual-reporting workflow described above.



Applications without this Loom will not be reviewed.

We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.

If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. title: Crypto BD Lead (Player-Coach)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented.

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference
description:
## Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference



We are an automotive parts company looking for a reliable full-time remote team member to help our sales team identify the correct automotive parts quickly and accurately.



### Main Responsibilities



* Search automotive parts by VIN, vehicle details, engine code, and model

* Identify correct OEM / OE part numbers

* Find aftermarket alternatives and cross-reference part numbers

* Work with TecDoc and other automotive parts catalogs

* Compare part numbers between different suppliers and manufacturers

* Update product and supplier mappings in our ERP system

* Prepare information for our sales team so they can quote customers quickly

* Check unclear or difficult vehicle/part matches

* Keep records organized and accurate

* Report when there are multiple possible parts or when you are not 100% sure



### Very Important



Accuracy is more important than speed.



We do not want someone who guesses.



If there are two possible parts for a vehicle, you must clearly report that further verification is required.



### Experience We Prefer



Experience with any of the following is a big advantage:



* TecDoc

* OEM / OE automotive part numbers

* VIN lookup

* EPC systems

* Parts catalogues

* Bosch

* MANN

* MAHLE

* Denso

* Valeo

* VAG / ETKA

* BMW ETK

* Mercedes EPC

* Toyota / Hyundai / Kia / Japanese or European vehicle catalogues

* Automotive spare parts e-commerce or wholesale companies



### Work Style



This is not a customer service role.



You will mainly work as a back-office automotive parts research specialist supporting our sales team.



You must be:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching difficult cases

* Able to follow procedures

* Comfortable using Excel / Google Sheets / ERP systems

* Honest when you are unsure about a part match



### Working Hours



Full-time preferred.



Working hours should overlap with Israel business hours for at least part of the day.



Israel time is UTC+2 / UTC+3 depending on daylight saving time.



### Salary



Starting salary: **USD $650–$800 per month**, depending on automotive parts experience and skill level.



Salary can increase after the probation period based on accuracy, productivity, reliability, and ability to work independently.



### Application Test



Please do not send a generic application.



In your application, answer these questions:



1. Have you worked with automotive spare parts before? Please explain.

2. Have you used TecDoc? For how long?

3. Which EPC or automotive catalog systems have you used?

4. Are you comfortable finding OE/OEM numbers using a VIN?

5. Which vehicle brands do you know best?

6. Give one example of how you would verify that a part definitely fits a specific vehicle.

7. What is your expected monthly salary?

8. Can you work full-time?

9. What hours can you work in Philippine time?



Please start your application with the words:



**PARTS RESEARCH**



Applications without these words may not be reviewed.



### Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid practical test involving real vehicle and part lookup cases.



We will measure:



* Accuracy

* Speed

* Ability to cross-reference parts

* Ability to identify uncertainty

* Quality of documentation



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team.

title: Documentary Film Producer-Director — High-Conflict Custody Case

The story will be told primarily through a father’s experience, supported by court orders, hearing transcripts, filed pleadings, written communications, professional reports, witness interviews, and other verifiable evidence. THE BIG IDEA - WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS MORE THAN A NORMAL EDITING JOB



Right now our creative output is the bottleneck. Not the budget, not the product, not the audience - the number of finished ads we can put in front of people.



That is a strange and very specific problem to have: we can fund more ad spend than we can produce ads for. In paid advertising, creatives burn out. An ad that prints money today is tired in three weeks, and if there is nothing new to replace it, the whole account cools down.



So the number of ads you deliver is not a production statistic. It is the ceiling on how big this brand can get. That is the job.



This is a doer role, not a manager role. You produce. Nobody reports to you and you do not build a team. If that changes later, it changes because you made it obvious that it should.



WHAT YOU WILL PRODUCE



You must be able to produce all of these yourself, from a script I write:



- AI UGC ads - a generated person on camera talking about the product, with their cat

- VSL and advertorial cuts - longer sales videos cut to a script, with captions and B-roll

- Cartoon, claymation and stylized animation - cat content that is not photoreal

- 1:1 rebuilds of winning ads - we hand you an ad that already works and you rebuild it exactly, changing one variable. Same structure, same pacing, same feel, different hook or different actor.

- The cut itself - burned-in German captions, clean sans-serif, inside the safe zone, hook in the first two seconds, no dead air, exported to spec, vertical 9:16



About the 1:1 rebuilds, because this is where people drop out: if the reference has a cut on beat four, your version has a cut on beat four. "Close enough" is not a delivery. If you need creative freedom to stay motivated, you will not enjoy this role - and we would both rather find that out now.



THE GERMAN PART - AND WHY IT IS NOT A PROBLEM



Our ads are in German. You do not need to speak a word of German.



I write every script. I give it to you finished, in German. You generate the voiceover from my text, you burn in the captions from my text, and you cut it.



What I do need is that you are careful with a language you do not speak. That means: no dropped umlauts, no autocorrect quietly turning my words into something else, no captions cut off mid-word because you could not tell where the sentence ends. You copy what I send you exactly, character for character, and when the caption text and the voiceover do not match, you tell me instead of guessing.



People who have edited in a foreign language before know exactly what I mean. It is not hard - it is just attention.



STOP. READ THIS PART CAREFULLY.



Here is the first filter:



The very first word of your application message must be MANGO.



Not in the middle. Not at the end. The first word, on its own line, before anything else. Like this:



MANGO



Hi Erik, ...



If your message does not start with MANGO, I will not read it - no matter how good your portfolio is. This is not a joke and I will not make an exception. Most applicants will fail this, and that is fine.



ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



This is the part I care about most, so I am going to be very clear.



I am not looking for someone who never has a problem. Everybody gets sick. Power goes out. Family emergencies happen. Typhoons happen. I have zero problem with any of that.



What I have a problem with is silence.



If you are ill, if your internet dies, if a render fails and the delivery will be late - send me one message. Before the deadline, not after it. That is all I ask, and if you do it, we will always find a solution together.



Going quiet on a delivery is the one thing that ends this immediately. Not because I am strict, but because I plan ad launches around your delivery date and I cannot plan around someone I have to chase.



Beyond that, I expect three things:



- You ask before you produce. When a brief is unclear, you ask first, instead of delivering five wrong ads and then explaining them.

- You flag what will not work. If a script cannot be built visually, tell me before you start, not after the render.

- You work independently. You do not need to be reminded or micromanaged.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING (hard requirements - no exceptions)



1. A PORTFOLIO. Links to 2-3 finished videos or ads you made yourself. Own work only. This is requirement number one and there is no way around it.



2. 2+ years producing or editing short-form video, and at least the last year of it working with AI-generated footage.



3. You have shipped AI video in production - for clients, for a brand, or for your own offers. Not tutorials, not test renders. I want to see the actual videos.



4. Hands-on with a serious AI generation stack of your choice, and the judgment to know when a generation is unusable and has to be redone instead of shipped. Which tools you use is up to you - I pay for them either way.



5. CapCut or Premiere Pro for the cut, your pick, as long as the output is consistent.



6. Comfortable working with AI voiceover (ElevenLabs or similar), including voices in a language you do not speak.



7. Conversational English, spoken and written.



8. Reliable internet and a machine that can actually handle video work.



9. Willing to sign a freelance contract and a short NDA before you get access to our assets.



10. Willing to do a short unpaid test task before we get on a call. It is small - roughly one to two hours of work - and it is the same thing you would do on the job.



BONUS (not required, but it moves you to the top of my list)



- You have produced paid ads before, not just organic content

- Experience in the pet niche - cats especially

- After Effects

- You have edited in a language you do not speak

- Music-driven ads, avatar ads, Disney-style or claymation animation

- You have built your own generation workflow and can explain why it is faster than the obvious one



THE TOOLS - I PAY FOR EVERYTHING



I pay for every tool account, every subscription and every generation credit. You never spend your own money on this job, and you never pay for a credit out of your own pocket.



Which AI generation tool you produce in is your choice. If you are fast in Higgsfield, use Higgsfield. If your stack is Veo, Kling, Sora, Midjourney, Runway or something I have not heard of yet, use it and tell me why it is better. Same for the cut - CapCut or Premiere, whatever you are fastest in.



What I care about is the finished ad, not the software. Tell me in your application what you need and I will buy it.



Voiceover runs through ElevenLabs or comparable. Communication runs on WhatsApp and
. Files live in a shared drive with a fixed folder structure and naming convention.



WHAT I PROVIDE



- Every tool, every subscription and every generation credit, fully paid

- The script for every ad - you never write copy, and you never have to write in German

- Product photos, existing footage, brand assets and reference ads, so "done" is never a guess

- Format specs, so you always know what correct looks like

- One revision round per delivery, with specific feedback, not vague feedback

- Direct access to me. No account manager, no layers.



WORKING HOURS AND WHERE THIS ROLE IS GOING



- 100% remote, from anywhere in the Philippines

- The work is asynchronous. No shift, no fixed working hours, no being on call. You get a brief, you deliver by the agreed date, and how you organize your day is your business.

- No overlap with my time zone required. I am in Europe. You will not be asked to work nights.

- Right now: roughly 10 to 15 hours per week. It depends on how much we are testing. I am not going to pretend this is a fixed 40-hour job today.

- Where this is going: we are scaling and creative volume is our bottleneck, so the hours grow. The plan is to grow this into a much bigger role for the right person - more hours, more responsibility, more pay.

- One fixed 30-minute call per week, camera on. We agree on the day and time together once you start, and then it stays there. That is where we go through what landed, what did not, what you need from me, and what I want produced next. I give direct feedback and I expect you to use it. I also expect you to tell me when a brief is bad or a spec makes no sense. That call goes both ways.

- English is our working language.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



1. Finished videos delivered per week

2. Turnaround time per delivery - agreed date, hit every time

3. Revision rounds per video - target: one or fewer

4. Spec compliance - correct format, safe zone, captions, naming, folder

5. German text accuracy - captions and voiceover exactly as I sent them

6. Communication - I always know where you are



COMPENSATION (all amounts in USD)



$5 per hour, for the hours you actually work, tracked.



At 10 to 15 hours per week that is roughly $200 to $320 per month today - and both the hours and the rate grow as we scale. I move people up when they earn it. I have never lost a great person over money and I do not plan to start.



Also included:



- Paid twice a month, on time, via Wise or PayPal

- Every tool, subscription and generation credit paid by me

- Bonuses when the business does well - when we grow, you grow

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- 13th month bonus after one full year

- Freelance contract and NDA

- Long-term position - I want one person who gets faster every month, not a one-off gig



One honest note: at today's hours this is a part-time income. If you currently work with another client, that is completely fine with me, as long as my deliveries are on time. As we scale, this role is meant to become your main one.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not
 me - I read everything in this system and nowhere else.



Start your message with MANGO on its own line. Then answer all 6 questions. Be specific - vague answers are the fastest way to get rejected.



1. YOUR PORTFOLIO. Links to 2-3 videos or ads YOU made. Own work only - no agency reels, no team projects, no "I was part of the team that". For each one: which tools you used, which parts were AI-generated, and what exactly your part was. If there are no links in your message, I will not reply.



2. YOUR AI WORK SPECIFICALLY. Which AI generation tools do you produce in today, and what have you actually shipped with them? Pick one AI video you linked above and walk me through how you made it - what you generated, what failed, and what you had to redo.



3. YOUR SPEED AND YOUR SETUP. How many finished 15-second vertical ads can you produce in one working day, starting from a script? A real number, not "many". Which cutting program do you use, what computer do you work on, and what is your internet speed?



4. FOREIGN LANGUAGE. You will build ads in German from my scripts. You do not need to speak German. Tell me: how do you make sure captions in a language you do not speak end up 100% correct on screen - no missing letters, no cut-off words, no mismatch with the voiceover? Have you edited in a language you do not speak before? Which one?



5. YOUR SITUATION. When can you start? How many hours per week can you commit right now? Are you okay with $5 per hour with tracked hours, and with a short unpaid test task before we get on a call? What tools would you want me to pay for?



6. A 60-SECOND RECORDING OF YOURSELF SPEAKING ENGLISH. Loom, a voice message, an unlisted YouTube link, whatever is easiest. Introduce yourself and walk me through one of the videos you linked. No production, no script, no editing - phone camera or just audio is completely fine, and I mean that. This is the one thing you send me that is not supposed to look produced. I am not judging your setup or your confidence on camera. I want to hear how you speak English.



Applications that do not start with MANGO, or that skip any of the 6 questions, or that have no portfolio links, will not be reviewed. I am strict about this on purpose - following a brief exactly is the single most important part of this job.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. I read your application and look at your portfolio

2. Short unpaid test task on a real brief - one finished ad, about one to two hours of work. I send you the script, the assets and the specs.

3. Video call in English, camera on, with the people whose test task convinced me

4. Hire, first paid deliveries, then we review the rate



I keep the number of test tasks small on purpose, so if you get there, you are already a serious candidate.



I read every application that follows the instructions, and I reply fast.



If this sounds like you, apply today. I am hiring one person and I am hiring quickly.



Start your message with: MANGO

The Digital Operations Implementation Specialist will work directly with our team to help build, configure, customize, test, and launch Digital Operations Centers for our clients.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
