title: Operations Manager — Coaching Program (AI & Automation Knowledge Required) | Long-Term, Full-Time
description:
If you're looking for a job where someone tells you what to do each morning, this isn't it. We already have people who can hand out tasks. What we don't have is someone who looks at how we run, sees what's broken, and fixes it before anyone asks.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — save yourself the application.



Who we are

We're Digital Kairos. We run Brick by Brick, a cohort-based coaching program that helps consultants, coaches, and business owners build their brand and get clients on LinkedIn. Members join in classes of about 30, do daily homework, hit milestones, get on teaching calls, and lay bricks — literally, we mail them one.



We're a small remote team, mostly US-based, and we move fast. Our members pay real money and they get real results, and the reason that works is that the operations behind them are tight. Right now those operations run on people remembering things. We want them to run on systems.



That's your job.

-------------------



What you'll actually do:

Run the machine. Every cohort has a rhythm: applications come in, people get approved, they pay, they get onboarded, they get channels and access, they do homework, they hit milestones, they unlock calls, they graduate, some move up to our next-level program. You own all of it, start to finish, for every member. Nothing slips through.



Build the machine. This is the part that matters most. Right now too much of the above happens by hand — 30 individual messages sent one at a time, progress counted manually across 30 channels, recordings uploaded one by one. You'll use Claude, Zapier, and whatever else works to automate it, so the next class costs us less time than the last one. We already have a list of things waiting to be built. You'll add to it.



Organize us. Our team lives in Slack and we're mid-migration into Notion. Things live in three places and belong in one. You'll bring structure — clean systems, written processes, one source of truth — and hold us to it.



Take care of our members. You'll message our members more than anyone else on our team does. When someone falls behind, you notice. When someone's confused, you fix it before it becomes a complaint. When someone wins, you catch it and make sure it gets celebrated. This part isn't admin work — it's the experience people paid for.



Tell us what's happening. Over-communicate. Every week we want to know what shipped, what's at risk, what you noticed, and what you're changing. If you go quiet, we assume something's wrong.



-------------------



Your first 90 days

So you know this is a real job with real work waiting, here's some of what's actually sitting on the list:



- Write the cohort rulebook — every deadline, threshold, and unlock in one document, so nobody has to ask again

- Automate our application and onboarding flow (it's been on our list since June)

- Fix a broken Zapier automation between our contract and invoicing tools

- Automate our milestone messages, which are currently sent by hand, one member at a time

- Build a dashboard that shows who's behind, replacing manual counting

- Write our offboarding process, which currently exists only in people's heads



-------------------



What you need to have

- 2+ years running operations for a cohort program, membership, mastermind, online course, or coaching business. You've done this specific kind of work, not adjacent work.

- Slack at an admin level — channels, user groups, workflows, permissions

- Notion as a builder — you make databases and views, you don't just fill them in

- Zapier or Make — you've built multi-step automations with conditional logic, and you've debugged one that broke at a bad time

- AI as a daily tool. We run on Claude. You should already be using AI to do your actual work, not experimenting with it on the side. If you've set up projects, custom instructions, or recurring automated tasks, say so.

- Skool, Zoom, Calendly, Google Workspace — or the confidence to be fluent in a week

- Excellent written English. You'll write messages that go directly to our paying members. We need to trust you to hit send.

- Availability that overlaps US business hours — roughly 9AM–5PM US Central, which is about 10PM–6AM Philippine time. Being straight with you: this is a night shift. Please only apply if that genuinely works for your life.





-------------------



Nice to have

- Dashboard building, other no-code tools, experience writing SOPs for a team that had none, experience running two cohorts at once.



Pay and growth

- $1,200 USD/month, full-time

- 90-day review with a clear path to $1,500/month — tied to documenting the cohort playbook and shipping two working automations, not to a calendar date

- Quarterly performance bonus tied to member completion rates and automations shipped

- 13th month pay

- Paid time off and Philippine holidays

- This is a long-term role with room above it. As we grow, this seat grows — more programs, more systems, and eventually people to lead. We're hiring someone to build a career here, not to fill a gap.



-------------------



What working with us is like

We're direct and we move fast. We'd rather you try something and get it wrong than wait for permission. If you're stuck for more than an hour, ask — but come with what you already tried.



We don't micromanage, and we don't want to. The tradeoff is that we need you to be the kind of person who doesn't need it. For the first 30 days a teammate will review your member-facing messages while you learn our voice. After that, you send them yourself.



----------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

Read this carefully. We're using it to filter, and most applications will not make it past this section.



1. Subject line. Use exactly this, filling in the blank with your favorite automation tool:

Brick by Brick Ops — [your favorite automation tool]



2. In your message, answer these two questions. Keep it short — a few sentences each. We care about specifics, not polish.



Q1. Tell us about one workflow you automated. What tool did you use, what broke, and what did you do about it?

Q2. Here's a real situation. You have 30 members. Nine of them are behind on homework. There's a teaching call in four hours, and the rule for this week's homework requirement isn't written down anywhere. What do you do in your first hour — and what would you build so this never happens again?



3. Record a 2-minute Loom and paste the link. We watch all of them, and we can tell when it's the same video sent to fifty companies. Answer these three, in order:



- Who are you and what do you do now?

- Show us how you actually use AI in your work. Don't describe it — share your screen and walk us through something real you built or use.

- What made you apply to this job specifically? And tell us one thing you'd change about how we've described the role, or something you noticed we might be getting wrong.



Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed. Applications with a generic Loom won't either.



-------------------



What happens next: if your Loom lands, we'll send you a short practical exercise — about an hour, using a real (anonymized) week from our program. Then one conversation with our founder and our Head of Community, then an offer. We move quickly.



We're excited to meet you. Please only apply if you read all of this — we'll know.

title: Video Editor for Social Media Agency - Full-Time Only
description:
Jeong X is a social + content agency that builds and runs “money models” for expert, education, and news brands. Our clients are serious operators who publish a lot of content and care about real business results, not vanity metrics.



We’re hiring a full‑time Video Editor to join our remote team.

This is a production-heavy editing role: you’ll be cutting YouTube videos, short‑form clips (Reels/TikTok/Shorts), and simple graphics‑heavy pieces using our templates and SOPs. The most important traits are: you learn fast, you don’t repeat the same mistake twice, and you communicate clearly.



APPLY HERE: 



What you’ll do

You will:

* Edit short‑form videos (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) from talking‑head or news clips:

    * Cut for pace and retention.

    * Add captions, simple graphics, b‑roll, music, and sound effects using our templates.

* Edit long‑form videos (YouTube, podcasts, educational / documentary content) based on scripts and story outlines.

* Follow brand guidelines and SOPs for each client:

    * Fonts, colors, layouts, pacing rules, thumbnails (when needed).

* Collaborate with social media managers, motion designers, and other editors:

    * Take feedback, apply notes quickly, and update future edits based on what you’ve learned.

* Prepare clean exports and organized project files for review and publishing.



This role is not about crazy VFX or advanced 3D. We care most about strong storytelling, pacing, and clean execution at volume.



What success looks like (first 90 days)

By month 3, you:

* Consistently deliver multiple edits per day at our quality bar.

* Rarely repeat the same mistake twice once it has been documented.

* Maintain a high “clean pass” rate (most edits approved with minimal changes).

* Communicate proactively about progress, blockers, and deadlines.

* Can take a new client’s SOP and match their style quickly without constant supervision.



Must‑have

* Strong experience editing for YouTube and/or social video (send links to your best work).

* Solid sense of pacing, storytelling, and rhythm:

    * You know how to cut out fluff and keep viewers watching.

* Comfortable with basic motion and graphics:

    * Captions, simple transitions, on‑screen text, reframes, zooms.

* Learns fast:

    * You can read a style guide, watch a few examples, and quickly match the look/feel.

* Doesn’t repeat mistakes:

    * When you get feedback, you apply it not just to that edit, but to all future edits.

* Reliable communication:

    * Responds during agreed work hours.

    * Gives daily updates on what’s done, what’s in progress, and what’s stuck.

* Fluent in English - reading, writing, and speaking

* Stable internet and a machine that can handle modern 4K editing workloads.



Nice to have

* Experience editing news, commentary, or documentary‑style content.

* Thumbnail experience (designing or collaborating on concepts).

* Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills.

* Familiarity collaborating with motion designers and following their graphics packs.



Tools you’ll use

* Primary: Adobe Premiere Pro 

* Also helpful: After Effects for simple motion

* Communication via Slack, Notion, and Google Drive.

title: Motion Design Artist (After Effects Specialist) – Full Time, Remote
description:
We’re looking for a full‑time Motion Design Artist (After Effects Specialist) to join Jeong X (Jeong Media).

You’ll work across multiple brands, side‑by‑side with our editors, to turn good cuts into premium, story‑driven pieces with maps, archival containers, titles, transitions, and depth/blur passes.



APPLY HERE: 



What you’ll do

You will

Design the motion system for each client

Build reusable AE templates for titles, lower thirds, info cards, archival footage containers, transitions, and “visual language” per brand.

Set up smart precomps, expressions, and project structures so you can move fast later.

Create complex story sequences

Animated maps with 3D camera moves, labels, and paths.

Timeline / process sequences that explain events clearly.

Multi‑layer compositions that combine footage, graphics, and text.

Handle depth, blur, and polish at scale

Create per‑scene blur maps and depth‑of‑field looks for many shots in a row.

Clean up and stabilize rough or archival footage with designed frames/containers so nothing feels “dropped on the timeline.”

Work across several clients

Support 2–4 active brands at a time (docs, news, long‑form YouTube).

Take a finished edit from our video editors and add motion that makes the story clearer and more cinematic.

Ship work fast and clean

Maintain organized AE projects (naming, folders, precomps) so others can jump in.

Take notes, turn revisions quickly, and keep quality consistent across dozens of shots.

What success looks like (first 90 days)

By month 3, you

Have complete AE template packs for each assigned client (titles, containers, lower thirds, transitions, map styles).

Are comfortably delivering motion on multiple videos per week (dozens of shots / scenes, not just one hero piece).

Can take a brief + edit and independently d
 the right motion approach for each moment.

Communicate reliably in Slack, hit deadlines, and don’t need to be chased for updates.

What we’re looking for (must‑have)

Deep After Effects expertise

3D camera / keyframe animation

Multi‑layer comps and precomp management

Compositing and finishing

Real motion design taste: typography, spacing, timing, and how to make graphics feel “premium,” not cheesy.

Story-first mindset: you design to make ideas clearer and more engaging, not to show off random effects.

Strong map / sequence experience

Animated maps or similar 3D‑camera explainer sequences in AE (show examples).

Capacity for high output: you’re comfortable doing lots of shots per week once systems/templates are in place.

Detail obsession: you can stay consistent on repetitive work (blur maps, DOF, many similar shots) without quality dropping.

Remote team skills: reliable internet, good communication in English, can take written briefs and collaborate asynchronously.

Portfolio / reel required showing

Map / 3D camera work

Documentaries / explainers / long‑form

Premium YouTube or social work

Nice to have

3D beyond AE (Cinema 4D, Blender, or Element 3D).

Extra compositing depth: tracking, roto, keying, cleanup.

Strong design chops in Photoshop / Illustrator.

Familiarity with Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve for smooth handoff with editors.

Sound design or audio polish experience.

How we work

Full‑time, long‑term, fully remote role.



You’ll report to our post‑production lead and work closely with multiple video editors.



We care about ownership and consistency: we’d rather have one person deeply invested in our brands than 5 freelancers doing the bare minimum.



If you want to spend your days inside AE, building systems and shipping a high volume of cinematic, story‑driven motion graphics for docs and news content, we’d love to see your reel.

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Lead: Inventory Planning & Demand Forecasting (Amazon FBA)
description:
We run two complementary e-commerce Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell across Amazon US, UK &.Canada, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardize where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships and procurement: purchase orders (POs): production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: replenishment timing, 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cash-flow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales (a lightweight S&OP rhythm), so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain or inventory management, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA

— Hands-on purchasing experience with overseas manufacturers: raising POs, tracking production, reconciling deliveries

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must overlap with China and UK hours (e.g., roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400+/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000+), equivalent to $11 to $14+ per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

title: Customer Service Representative (Phone-Based) — Australian Packaging Company
description:
About us:

APAC Packaging Solutions is a fast-growing packaging supply company based in Brisbane, Australia. We supply 300+ cafes, restaurants, and takeaway shops with their weekly packaging, and produce custom printed packaging (branded cups, pizza boxes, bags) for clients across Australia. We're a small, tight team — this is our first dedicated customer service hire, and you'll be the friendly first voice of the company.



The role:

Answering inbound calls from Australian customers and new enquiries on our cloud phone system (JustCall)

Sorting each call: hot sales enquiries transferred to the owner, account matters to our account manager, simple questions handled by you using our knowledge base and scripts

Responding to missed calls and texts; logging every enquiry in our CRM (
)

Friendly follow-up calls and texts to leads and customers

Keeping the CRM clean — every call logged, nothing falls through the cracks

Full training provided — detailed scripts, a knowledge base, and call guides are ready and waiting. You just need a computer, quality headset, quiet workspace, and reliable internet.



Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00am–6:00pm Brisbane time (AEST). No night shifts, no weekends.



What we're looking for:

Excellent spoken English — clear, warm, and natural on the phone. An Australian accent (or long experience serving Australian customers) is strongly preferred — our callers are Aussie shop owners and tradies, and it should feel easy and familiar when they ring us

Experience in phone-based customer service (Australian customers a big plus)

Warm, confident phone manner — our callers are busy people who appreciate friendly and quick

Organised and detail-focused — every call gets logged, nothing slips

Reliable internet, quiet home workspace, quality headset

CRM or cloud phone experience a plus (
 / JustCall ideal, not required)



What we offer:

Competitive salary, paid on time every time [state your range]

Permanent, stable full-time role — we're building long-term and want someone who grows with us

Direct access to the business owners — no layers, your work matters here

A front-row seat in a fast-scaling business, not just a phone job



HOW TO APPLY — applications without a voice recording will not be considered:



Record a 1–2 minute voice message: introduce yourself, your customer service background, and answer this: "Thanks for calling APAC Packaging Solutions, this is [name] — how can I help you today? ... Oh no, I'm really sorry to hear the delivery hasn't turned up, especially right on the lunch rush. Let me sort that out for you straight away. Can I grab your business name and suburb? ... Beautiful, thank you. And just so you know, if you're ever after custom printed gear — branded coffee cups, pizza boxes, kebab bags, that sort of thing — we do all of that too, and we deliver right across Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne. I'll get the team onto your delivery now, and someone will call you back within the hour. Thanks so much for your patience — have a good one!" Speak naturally, exactly as you'd answer our phone. (Use 
 or attach an MP3.)



Put the word "KOALA" in the first line of your application.



Attach your CV and an internet speed test screenshot (speedtest.net).

title: IT / Web Operations — Long Term, Full-Time Remote
description:

These are seats we want filled for years, not short projects. We want dedicated applicants who are already familiar with how websites run on the server side.



Background:  

IT / Web: you've built websites and understand domains, hosting, DNS, and WordPress





Preferred ( Not required ):

SEO: you've done off-page work (guest posts, outreach, link building) and used Ahrefs or Semrush



No formal experience needed if you can show real self-taught work and have simple knowledge on how domains/websites work. The workflow is simple and you will have training.



Non-negotiables

70+ WPM typing

100+ Mbps internet

Available 6 days a week

Clear, fast English communication and high attention to detail



Nice to have:

Gaming background, FPS or strategy. Both build the pattern recognition and speed this work rewards.

Experience coordinating with a team

Have simple knowledge on web operations





Salary



PHP 15,000–20,000/month to start, based on demonstrated skill. Reviewed on performance.



How to apply



 



Subject line: IT/WebOps - [YourFirstName] - ANCHOR



Include:



Short intro: who you are and what you've built or worked on

Why this role interests you

Resume

Typing test screenshot

Internet speed test screenshot

Links or screenshots of sites you've built, or examples of links you've placed

title: Accountant/Accounts Assistant
description:
Accountant/Bookkeeper with VA and Project Management Support.



We need someone who can hit the ground running, only apply if you have Xero qualified/experience with a client and a verified profile.



We are a small, growing UK accounting practice supporting clients mainly within the charity sector. Our two partners also provide fractional CFO services, and we are looking for an experienced person who can grow with the practice long term.



Key responsibilities:



* Bookkeeping and maintaining accurate accounting records

* Bank reconciliations and general account management

* Supporting the preparation of management accounts and reports

* Managing client queries and following up outstanding information

* Providing virtual assistant support to the two partners

* Organising meetings, tasks, deadlines and project updates

* Attending online meetings with UK clients



Requirements:



* Strong accounting and bookkeeping experience

* Good working knowledge of Xero

* FreeAgent experience is helpful but not essential

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong organisation and project-management skills

* Reliable, honest, proactive and able to work independently

* Stable, high-speed Wi-Fi and reliable computer equipment

* Comfortable attending daily Teams check-ins and client meetings with the camera switched on



This is a long-term position requiring full commitment during agreed working hours. You must not work simultaneously for another employer or client during those hours.



Please apply and share your LinkedIn details, accounting experience with Xero, availability and expected salary.

title: Full-Time Graphic Designer
description:
FULL-TIME GRAPHIC DESIGNER

Remote Contract Position | Carnes Agency



Carnes Agency is growing, and we are looking for a talented, well-rounded Graphic Designer to join our six-person team.



This is a long-term, full-time contract position for someone who loves design, has a sophisticated creative point of view, and takes pride in producing polished, thoughtful work.



ABOUT CARNES AGENCY



Carnes Agency is a boutique marketing, communications, PR, branding, and digital consultancy based in the United States.



We work primarily with businesses and leaders in the hospitality industry, along with clients in education, technology, professional services, and other growing industries.



Our work includes branding, social media,
 marketing, websites, digital campaigns, public relations, thought leadership, executive communications, presentations, and other strategic marketing initiatives.



We are a small team with a very high standard for our work. Our environment is fast-paced, collaborative, creative, and detail-oriented.



We work hard, move quickly, and care deeply about delivering exceptional work for our clients. At the same time, we believe in creating a supportive, positive, and fun working environment.



Learn more about Carnes Agency at:



[
](
)



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is primarily a graphic design position.



We are looking for a sophisticated, versatile designer who can move comfortably between different types of creative work while maintaining a consistently high level of quality.



Your work may include:



* Social media graphics and carousels

* eBooks and downloadable resources

* Infographics and data-driven visuals

* Website and landing page design

*
 marketing design

* Presentations and marketing materials

* Branded templates

* Campaign creative

* Basic video editing

* Short-form social media video content



Video editing is part of the role, but it is not the primary focus.



We are looking first and foremost for an excellent graphic designer who is also comfortable editing video when needed.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate has:



* A strong, sophisticated, and consistent graphic design portfolio

* Excellent typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy skills

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong visual judgment

* A refined sense of spacing, balance, proportion, imagery, and brand consistency

* Experience designing across multiple formats and screen sizes

* Strong social media design experience

* Experience designing eBooks, reports, infographics, or other long-form marketing materials

* Experience with website and landing page design

* Experience with
 marketing design

* Experience using Figma

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and/or other professional design programs

* Familiarity with Mailchimp and Constant Contact

* Basic-to-intermediate video editing experience using Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools

* Experience working from creative briefs

* Experience following established brand guidelines

* Ability to adapt to multiple client brands and visual identities

* Strong written and spoken English

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

* Ability to receive feedback and make thoughtful revisions quickly

* Reliable communication and responsiveness



Previous agency experience and experience working with U.S.-based clients are a plus.



A portfolio demonstrating range across social media, digital, web, and long-form design is especially important.



WHAT MATTERS MOST



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use design software.



We are looking for someone with strong taste, thoughtful design judgment, and a genuine love for creating sophisticated visual work.



You should notice the details.



You should care about typography, alignment, spacing, hierarchy, consistency, and whether the final piece truly feels finished.



You should be equally comfortable designing a polished social media carousel, laying out an eBook, creating an infographic, developing a landing page concept, or designing an
 campaign.



You must also be comfortable working within established client brands. Much of your work will begin with a creative brief, brand guidelines, and content from our team. You will be expected to understand the objective and translate that direction into polished, professional creative.



We value designers who can bring ideas and creative perspective to the work while also knowing when the assignment requires disciplined execution within an existing brand.



WORK SCHEDULE



This is a full-time contract position requiring 40 hours per week.



Because our team and clients are based in the United States, you must be available to work on Eastern Time (ET).



There is some flexibility in your daily schedule.



Your shift may begin anytime between 8:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, followed by your regular eight-hour workday.



For example:



8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET

9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET

10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET



We are looking for someone who can maintain a consistent schedule and be available during our normal working hours for collaboration, meetings, feedback, and client needs.



COMPENSATION



The starting compensation for this position is $275 USD per week, paid weekly.



After the first 60 days, we will conduct a performance and compensation review.



At that time, you may be eligible for an increase in weekly compensation based on demonstrated design expertise, quality and consistency of work, attention to detail, reliability, communication, ability to apply feedback, ability to work independently, and overall contribution to the Carnes Agency team.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, and strong performance will be recognized accordingly.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



* Your resume

* A brief introduction about yourself

* A link to your graphic design portfolio

* Examples of social media design

* Examples of eBooks, reports, infographics, or other long-form design work

* Examples of website, landing page, or
 design

* Examples of video editing work, if available

* A brief description of your experience working from creative briefs and established brand guidelines

* Your experience with Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, and other design programs

* Your experience working with U.S.-based clients or agencies, if applicable

* Confirmation that you are available to work full-time on Eastern Time



Your portfolio will be one of the most important parts of our review.

title: Customer Success and Implementation Manager
description:
About DCRM



DCRM is a CRM and automation platform for private dental practices in Australia. We help practices improve lead response, appointment conversion, missed-call handling, client communication and marketing attribution.



We are hiring a Customer Success and Implementation Manager to own the client journey from signed agreement through implementation, onboarding and ongoing success.



This is not a general virtual assistant, documentation or customer support role. You will assess situations, recommend the next action, coordinate the people involved and drive work through to completion.



DCRM is still developing some of its operating playbooks. You will work closely with our Process and Knowledge Coordinator, who owns process documentation, templates, checklists and knowledge maintenance. Your responsibility is to make sound operational decisions, lead client outcomes and identify recurring situations or process gaps for documentation.



What you will own



• Sales-to-Customer-Success handover

• Client implementation plans, deadlines and dependencies

• Data collection and implementation readiness

• Client onboarding and training calls

• Pre-launch testing and quality control

• Coordination with technical and operations team members

• Clear client updates, expectations and next steps

• Escalations with a recommended decision

• Account health, adoption and retention

• Identification of recurring issues and process gaps for the Process and Knowledge Coordinator



What the Process and Knowledge Coordinator owns



• Building and maintaining playbooks

• Updating checklists, templates and the Customer Success knowledge base

• Documenting repeatable lessons from completed client work

• Maintaining ClickUp process records

• Supporting consistent execution across the team



What success looks like



• Clients always know what is happening, who owns the next step and when they will hear from us

• Risks are identified before they affect a launch

• Technical issues are explained in simple language

• Work progresses without constant founder follow-up

• Client communication is concise, confident and action-oriented

• Implementation tasks are completed accurately and on time

• Process gaps are identified clearly and handed to the Process and Knowledge Coordinator after the operational decision is made



Required experience



• 3 or more years in B2B SaaS customer success, software implementation, account management or a similar client-facing role

• Experience owning client onboarding from handover through launch

• Strong spoken and written English

• Experience coordinating technical delivery without needing to be a developer

• Confidence leading video calls with Australian business clients

• Strong CRM and project-management experience

• Sound judgment when information is incomplete

• Reliable internet, professional video-call setup and availability during Australian business hours



Preferred experience



• Australian client experience

• Healthcare, dental, agency or professional-services experience

• Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM automation platform such as HubSpot, Salesforce or ActiveCampaign

• Experience managing multiple client accounts

• Experience working alongside process, quality or knowledge-management roles

• Commercial awareness around retention and account growth



How to apply



Please provide these details in writing:



• Your location

• The Australian business hours you are available to work

• Your years of relevant experience

• Your current or most recent role

• Your expected monthly salary

• A link to your Loom video



Loom video assessment



Record one continuous Loom video of no more than 5 minutes. No editing or special production is required. Answer all five questions in your own words:



1. Summarise your most relevant Customer Success or implementation experience.



2. Describe your GoHighLevel or CRM implementation experience. Explain what you personally owned rather than what your wider team delivered.



3. Give one example where you received an unclear client problem, formed a recommendation and drove it to resolution.



4. A dental practice is launching its new CRM in three days. SMS is not working, the developer says implementation is complete, required information is missing and the Practice Manager wants an update today. Explain what you would say to the Practice Manager and what you would do next.



5. Explain why you are suited to working in a business where some playbooks are still being developed.



We assess clarity, judgment, ownership, concision and client communication. We do not assess accent, camera quality or video editing.



Selection process



• Application review

• Short video and written scenario assessment

• Live interview

• Paid practical trial for finalists

• Reference check



Compensation



PHP 63,000 to PHP 74,000 per month, based on demonstrated experience and practical assessment.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role with direct access to the DCRM business owner and meaningful ownership of client outcomes.

title: YouTube Documentary Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
COMPENSATION: This is a per-video position, paid according to the length of each video, with real room to grow. These are trial / first-video rates - once you've proven your style, reliability, and turnaround, your per-video rate increases, and strong performers also earn performance bonuses and steady, growing volume. 



Starting rates:

10–15 minutes: $15 per video

16–25 minutes: $20 per video

26–35 minutes: $25 per video

60–80 minute features: from $45 per video (priced per project, as these are much larger)



Applicants seeking significantly higher starting compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to editors who are excited to start at these rates and grow with us long-term.



EXPECTED WORKLOAD: We are looking for an editor who can grow into a steady output of long-form videos. We'll start at approximately 8 videos per month while we learn each other's workflow, with the goal of scaling toward 12-18 per month as we build a consistent rhythm. We care more about retention and quality than raw volume - the exact workload will depend on channel needs and how the collaboration develops.



ABOUT US: We operate multiple faceless YouTube channels focused on: True-Crime, History, Forgotten Wealth, Dark Economics, Geopolitics, Forbidden Commodities, Business History, and Documentary Storytelling. We are looking for a skilled editor who understands YouTube's viewer retention and can transform a script and voice-over into an engaging documentary-style video.



IMPORTANT: This position is NOT for basic video editing. We're looking for editors who can build engaging documentary-style videos by combining storytelling, research, footage sourcing, graphics, music, and pacing - the difference between a slideshow and a film. 



Our aim is for every video to feel like a highly-produced, cinematic Netflix-style documentary - polished, immersive, and gripping from the first second to the last.



WHAT WE PROVIDE: For each video, we will provide:

1. Complete script

2. Voice-over recording

3. Reference YouTube video(s)

4. A channel style guide / template so your work stays on-brand and consistent

5. Occasionally, additional resources or specific assets to use for a particular video (you should still be comfortable sourcing everything yourself when we don't)

6. Creative direction and feedback using 



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Edit high-retention YouTube documentaries (typically 15–35 minutes, with some longer feature-length videos of 60–80 minutes)

2. Source relevant stock footage, photos, maps, graphics, animations, and B-roll

3. Source and add background music and sound effects that fit the tone

4. Ensure every asset you use - footage, images, music, and sound effects - is properly licensed and safe for YouTube monetization (no copyright-claimed or restricted material)

5. Add text, motion graphics, zooms, transitions, and visual storytelling elements

6. Follow the editing style of our reference videos and channel template. 

*Important Note: Because our channels cover real people and events, use only the clips and on-screen source citations we provide - keep sources visible where instructed, and never re-upload anyone's full video*

7. Deliver projects on schedule

8. Revise videos based on time-stamped feedback when necessary (we review edits on 
)



REQUIREMENTS:

1. Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos

2. Excellent storytelling and pacing skills

3. Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content

4. Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

5. Ability to independently source visuals and assets

6. A clear understanding of copyright and monetization safety - all footage, images, music, and sound effects must be cleared for commercial use so our videos are never demonetized or copyright-claimed.

7. Reliable communication and attention to detail

8. Good English comprehension

9. Willingness to use 
 (free) for our review process, where we leave timestamped comments for you to revise to



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

- Experience editing videos similar to: MagnatesMedia, golfcartmedia, J Wisdom, Influencers Exposed, Johnny Harris, Fern, Wendover Productions, Search Party, DRInsanityCrime and Modern MBA.



IMPORTANT - APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS To confirm you have read this entire job posting:

1. Include the word ATLAS as the second line of your application.

2. Record a short 30–60 second Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you're a good fit for this position.

3. Answer all application questions below.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be automatically rejected.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS:

1. Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited -  should be long-form (10+ minutes) -and explain your exact role in each project and provide us with the editing timeline.

2. Which editing software do you use? And are you willing to use 
 (free) for our review and revision process?

3. How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have?

4. Have you edited documentary, history, business, or storytelling channels before? Share examples if so.

5. If we provide only a script and voice-over, can you source all footage, images, maps, and graphics yourself? Please walk us through your process.

6. What sources do you use for stock footage, images, music, and sound effects - and are they licensed for commercial use and safe for YouTube monetization? Please be specific about the sites or libraries you rely on.

7. What YouTube channels inspire your editing style?

8. How many videos can you realistically edit per month at a high-retention quality bar? (Our videos are typically 15–35 minutes, with some longer 60–80 minute features.)

9. How many hours per week are you available, and what hours of the day can you overlap with us for communication? (We work on GMT+3.)

10. What is your internet speed?

11. What is your expected rate per video? (Our videos are usually 15–35 minutes, with occasional 60–80 minute features.)

12. What is your typical turnaround time for a fully edited long form video (considering the length of our videos?)



FINAL SELECTION PROCESS: Shortlisted applicants will complete a 60-second sample edit using a script, voice-over recording, and reference video that we provide. The purpose of this test is to evaluate storytelling ability, editing style, visual sourcing skills, pacing and viewer retention, sound design, attention to detail, and ability to follow instructions.



NOTE: Please do not apply if you are unwilling to complete the sample edit. Due to the volume of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage will receive the test materials.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY: We are building multiple YouTube channels and are looking for a reliable editors to grow with us long-term. Strong performers will receive higher compensation, performance bonuses, additional editing projects, and opportunities to work across multiple channels.



Strong performers will receive:

- Higher monthly compensation

- Performance bonuses

- Additional editing projects

- Opportunities to work across multiple channels



If you're passionate about creating engaging documentary-style YouTube content, we'd love to hear from you.

title: International Growth Marketer
description:
International Growth Marketer



CoolHed Pty Ltd

Remote – International Applicants Welcome

Full-Time | Contractor or Employee

Start: Immediate

Location: Remote, with Gold Coast hybrid welcome



About CoolHed



CoolHed is an Australian company developing reusable cooling solutions for heat stress, athletic recovery, workplace safety, and everyday thermoregulation.



We are growing across Australia and expanding into the United States, Japan, and B2B workplace markets.



We're looking for an experienced Growth Marketer who can take ownership of our online marketing and help turn traffic into measurable sales.



This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone who enjoys running campaigns, testing ideas, improving conversions, and seeing measurable results.



The Role



As our International Growth Marketer, you'll be responsible for growing CoolHed through:



Paid advertising

Amazon

SEO

 & CRM

Website conversion

Lead generation

B2B sales support

Creative testing



You'll work directly with the Founder/CEO and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact as we expand into international markets.



Key Responsibilities

Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, manage, and optimise Meta, Google, and TikTok campaigns.

Test different creative concepts, hooks, offers, and audiences.

Manage advertising budgets based on performance.

Identify underperforming campaigns and improve or replace them.

Develop campaigns for Australia initially, followed by the US and other markets.

Amazon

Manage and improve Amazon listings.

Work with Amazon PPC campaigns and keyword targeting.

Improve product titles, bullet points, images, A+ Content, and backend keywords.

Monitor advertising performance, rankings, reviews, and inventory.

Help expand CoolHed across Amazon Australia, the US, and eventually Japan.

SEO & Content

Identify valuable commercial search opportunities.

Improve website pages, product pages, titles, internal linking, and SEO structure.

Create or coordinate useful content that can generate traffic and sales.

Use Google Search Console and other tools to monitor performance.

 & CRM

Manage
 marketing and customer flows.

Build and improve welcome, abandoned-cart, post-purchase, win-back, and other automated campaigns.

Segment customers and leads.

Monitor
 performance and revenue.

Maintain good
 deliverability and list hygiene.

Sales & Business Development

Support B2B lead generation and outreach.

Help create sales materials,
 sequences, and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.

Support follow-up with workplace, safety, mining, construction, healthcare, and other potential business customers.

Assist with affiliate and ambassador opportunities.

Help develop campaigns around seasonal opportunities and key markets.

Website & Conversion

Identify ways to improve the customer journey and checkout experience.

Develop landing pages for advertising campaigns.

Improve product pages, bundles, FAQs, offers, and trust elements.

Test different approaches to increase conversion rates.

What We're Looking For



We're looking for a hands-on marketer, not someone who simply manages an agency or delegates everything.



You should have experience with several of the following:



Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

TikTok Ads

Amazon Seller Central

Amazon PPC

Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar

Klaviyo or another
 marketing platform

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

Shopify

Canva / CapCut

CRM and marketing automation tools



Experience marketing physical products, e-commerce, Amazon, wellness, sports, outdoor products, workplace safety, or similar products is highly valued.



Qualifications & Skills

3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience is preferred.

Experience managing paid advertising for a physical product or e-commerce brand.

Strong understanding of performance marketing and conversion.

Experience with Amazon Seller Central and PPC is highly preferred.

Good understanding of
 marketing and CRM.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written English.

Able to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Comfortable testing, learning, and making decisions based on data.

Strong commercial mindset — you care about sales and profitable growth, not just likes and impressions.

Comfortable working remotely and providing regular updates.



You don't need to be an expert in every area. However, we are looking for someone who is capable of getting hands-on and making things happen.



What Success Looks Like



Your goal is simple: help CoolHed generate more profitable sales.



Over your first 90 days, you'll be expected to:



Audit our existing website, advertising, Amazon,
, and tracking.

Develop a clear growth plan.

Launch and optimise paid campaigns.

Improve our Amazon listings and PPC.

Establish effective
 flows.

Build reliable reporting and tracking.

Identify what is working and scale it.

Create repeatable marketing processes that the company can continue to use as we grow.

Compensation



Base: AUD $1,600 per month



Performance Bonus: 8% of Net Attributable Profit generated through the channels you manage.



The bonus is designed to reward profitable growth and is not capped during the first six months.



CoolHed also covers approved marketing software and tools required for the role.



First 60 days: Base compensation applies, with an additional one-off $400 kick-start bonus when the required Week-2 audit and Week-4 campaign setup are completed on time.



Working Arrangement

Remote / international applicants welcome.

Minimum 3 hours of overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) on campaign days.

Full-time commitment.

Contractor or employee arrangement depending on location and circumstances.

Immediate start available.

title: Instagram Engagement VA – Australian High-End Construction
description:
Instagram Engagement VA – Australian High-End Construction



GRW Developments | Melbourne, Australia

Remote – Philippines

Part-time: Approx. 5–7 hours per week



GRW Developments is a Melbourne-based construction company specialising in high-end residential and architectural builds.



We are looking for a reliable Instagram Engagement VA to help us actively engage with relevant people and businesses on Instagram and steadily grow our presence within the Australian construction industry.



Important: This is NOT a content creation role



We will continue to create and post all of our own photos, videos, Reels and project content.



Your role is to manage the daily engagement and activity around our account.



Your Role



You will spend approximately 1 hour per weekday actively using the GRW Developments Instagram account.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Like and engage with relevant Australian construction content

* Follow carefully selected and relevant accounts

* Leave genuine, thoughtful comments on posts

* Reply to comments made on GRW posts

* Re-engage with people who regularly interact with GRW

* Engage with followers of relevant Australian construction accounts

* Build relationships with people and businesses within the industry

* Identify interesting accounts for GRW to follow

* Flag important DMs, enquiries or potential opportunities for us

* Provide a simple weekly activity report



Who We Want GRW Engaging With



The primary focus is Melbourne and Australian high-end residential construction.



This includes:



* High-end residential builders

* Construction companies

* Carpenters and quality trades

* Building suppliers and manufacturers

* Construction photographers

* Developers

* Building industry publications

* Architects

* Interior designers

* Landscape designers

* Property and residential design accounts

* People genuinely interested in high-quality residential construction



The goal is quality, not follower numbers.



We want GRW’s Instagram network to represent the type and quality of construction work we undertake.



What We DON’T Want



No bots.



No automated engagement.



No mass following/unfollowing.



No spam DMs.



No generic comments such as “Amazing ????”, “Great work!” or copy-and-paste responses.



Every interaction from the GRW account should feel like it came from someone who genuinely looked at the project or post.



For example:



Good:

“Beautiful execution of the curved brickwork.”



Good:

“Really clean transition between the stone and timber.”



Bad:

“Awesome work ????????????”



Hours



Approximately 5–7 hours per week, Monday–Friday.



We would prefer smaller amounts of activity each day rather than completing all hours on one day.



This may become a larger ongoing role if it works well.



Rate



US$4–6 per hour, depending on experience.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person.



What We’re Looking For



* Excellent written English

* Good understanding of Instagram

* Experience with Instagram engagement/community management

* Strong attention to detail

* Able to understand the difference between high-quality construction content and generic building content

* Reliable and able to work independently

* Familiarity with Australian construction, property or real estate would be highly regarded



APPLICATION TEST



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



“GRW Melbourne”



Then answer these questions:



1. Have you previously managed Instagram engagement for a construction, property, real estate, architecture or similar business?



2. Please provide links to Instagram accounts you have previously worked on, if available.



3. Imagine GRW is commenting on each of the following posts. Write the exact comment you would leave:



A. A builder posts a completed high-end home featuring beautiful recycled brickwork.



B. A carpenter posts detailed exposed hardwood roof framing.



C. A stone supplier posts a newly completed natural stone crazy-paving project.



D. An architect posts a new residential project currently under construction in Melbourne.



E. A construction company posts a complicated concrete pour on a high-end residential project.



Keep each comment short and natural.



4. Tell us how you would find new Australian construction accounts for GRW to engage with.



5. What hourly rate are you seeking in USD?



We will shortlist applicants based primarily on the quality and naturalness of their answers to the application test rather than the length of their résumé.
salary: US$4–6 per hour, depending on experience

title: Video Editor — SaaS Product + Founder Personal Brand
description:
Remote · Philippines-Based · Long-Term Opportunity

And the personal brand of CASTLINE’s founder, an ecommerce founder who built a multi-seven-figure brand from the ground up and is now documenting the process of building her next company.



This is NOT a basic editing position.



We are looking for someone with strong creative taste who understands how to turn raw footage, screen recordings, founder videos, product demos, and lifestyle footage into content that feels professional, premium, modern, and highly engaging.



There will be a high volume of content, so we are looking for someone who wants a consistent, long-term role and can become deeply familiar with our brands and editing style.



WHAT YOU’LL EDIT



You’ll work across several different styles of content, including:



Professional founder videos

Talking-head social media videos

SaaS/product demonstrations

CASTLINE feature demos

Screen recordings and UI animations

Instagram Reels

TikTok videos

X/Twitter video content

Meta ad creatives

UGC-style advertisements

Founder storytelling

Ecommerce/business education

Brand-trip footage

Lifestyle/founder content

Cinematic brand videos

Short-form vertical content

Horizontal videos for websites, X, YouTube, etc.

Longer educational/founder videos over time



Some videos will be filmed professionally with a videographer.



Others will simply be filmed on an iPhone and need to be turned into strong, engaging social content.



You need to be comfortable editing both.



CASTLINE CONTENT



CASTLINE should feel like a premium, modern software company — not a generic AI startup.



You may receive a screen recording of someone typing:



“Find me 25 beachy creators in California.”



Your job might be to turn that into a beautiful product demo showing the search, results appearing, creator profiles, the user casting a creator, outreach, tracking, etc.



Product videos should feel:



clean, minimal, premium, fast, modern, easy to understand, and visually impressive.



We want viewers to understand the product within seconds.



PERSONAL BRAND CONTENT



You’ll also edit content for the founder’s personal social accounts.



Topics will include:



ecommerce, building companies, creator marketing, scaling brands, brand trips, founder lessons, mistakes, growth, marketing, building CASTLINE, and behind-the-scenes founder life.



Some videos may be simple 60–90 second talking-head clips.



Others will include professional footage, archival footage, screenshots, brand-trip footage, product footage, voiceovers, sound design, and storytelling.



The goal is to build a serious founder personal brand — not just promote CASTLINE.



THE STYLE WE WANT



We like editing that feels:



premium

clean

confident

modern

high-end

story-driven

fast enough to hold attention without feeling chaotic



We want strong hooks, good pacing, tasteful typography, clean captions, good sound design, thoughtful B-roll, and polished transitions.



We do NOT want every video filled with random zooms, emojis, memes, sound effects, or excessive motion graphics.



You should understand when a video needs energy and when simplicity makes it feel more expensive.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for a seasoned editor, not a complete beginner.



You should have professional experience editing short-form social content and be able to show a strong portfolio.



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent professional editing software is preferred.



Experience creating SaaS/product demos, motion graphics, UI animations, founder content, ecommerce content, ads, or personal-brand videos is a major advantage.



You should also:



Have excellent attention to detail

Understand social media hooks and retention

Know how to make talking-head footage interesting without overediting it

Be comfortable working with large amounts of footage

Be organized with files and revisions

Follow creative direction well

Also be capable of making creative decisions independently

Communicate clearly

Meet deadlines consistently

Be comfortable producing a high volume of videos

Be interested in a long-term position rather than a one-time project

BIG BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH



SaaS companies, software demos, ecommerce brands, founder personal brands, direct-response ads, Meta ad creative, UGC editing, motion graphics, After Effects, screen-recording animations, or building social accounts from the beginning.



VOLUME / LONG-TERM ROLE



We plan to create a lot of content.



This is not a position where you will edit one or two videos per month.



We are building a large content engine across CASTLINE and the founder’s personal brand, so there will be consistent work for the right person.



We want someone who can eventually understand our style so well that we don’t need to explain every edit from scratch.



There is significant room to grow with us as CASTLINE grows.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is negotiable based on experience, portfolio quality, editing ability, speed, and availability.



We are open to discussing a consistent monthly arrangement with the right person.



This is intended to become a long-term working relationship, not just a short freelance project.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



Your name and location in the Philippines

A link to your portfolio

3–5 examples of your BEST edits

Any SaaS/product-demo work you have done

Any founder/personal-brand videos you have edited

Software you edit with

Your typical turnaround time

Your availability each week

Your desired monthly rate or preferred compensation structure

A short explanation of why you think you would be a good fit



Important: Please do not send 30 random portfolio links. We would rather see your 5 strongest examples.



Shortlisted candidates may be offered a paid editing test using our footage before we make a long-term decision.



We are looking for someone with real editing skill, creative judgment, and strong taste who wants to grow with two ambitious brands.

title: Website QA & Remediation Specialist (WordPress / Elementor)
description:
Website QA & Remediation Specialist (WordPress / Elementor)

Find it. Fix it. Prove it's fixed



About the Role

Eden Digital manages SEO, content, and web operations for a portfolio of client websites — healthcare and behavioral-health practices, home-service companies, and local businesses. We run structured, audit-driven workflows: every site gets crawled, proofread, and technically audited, and the output is a prioritized findings list (CSV/GitHub issues) with exact quotes, URLs, and suggested fixes.



Your job has two halves: FIND the issues and FIX them — carefully, verifiably, and without breaking anything.



Sometimes we hand you a completed audit and you work the list down to zero. Just as often, you are the audit: you take a client site cold, sweep it end-to-end (copy, links, technical SEO, brand/design conformance), build the findings list yourself, and then remediate it. This is not a design role and not a dev-from-scratch role. It is a precision QA + remediation role: you detect an issue ("this FAQ answer is pasted from the wrong page," "this button dials the wrong number," "this section's background color is off-brand," "this link 404s on 49 pages"), document it, and fix it at the right level — page, template, or global — then prove it's fixed.



What You'll Fix (real examples from our audits)

Copy errors at scale: typos ("therpay"), grammar ("at it's roots"), wrong credentials in author boxes, sitewide footer typos — fixed once at the template level where possible, or via careful WP-CLI search-replace across Elementor JSON data. You can use AI to help you correct these issues, they just need to get done! 



Wrong-page content: FAQ answers pasted under the wrong question, sections copied from another service page, a team bio describing a different company, lorem ipsum and writer instructions left live



Factual drift: program hours, durations, phone numbers, service claims that contradict the client's canonical fact sheet — every instance verified against the brand repository before editing



Broken links and redirects: internal 404s, malformed hrefs, nav/footer links that pass through redirect chains, dead outbound citations



Technical SEO cleanup: duplicate meta-description emitters, missing metas and H1s, broken JSON-LD schema, sitemap hygiene (dead URLs, duplicates, noindex conflicts), image alt text



Design and brand corrections: wrong background colors, off-brand section styling, spacing and contrast issues, text below our 16px minimum, mobile responsiveness defects — corrected against each client's documented brand guide without redesigning anything



Accessibility basics: contrast, alt text, focus states, readable font sizes



Responsibilities

Finding (QA / auditing):



Run full-site QA sweeps on assigned client sites: crawl every page (sitemap + link discovery), proofread copy word-by-word, test all internal/external links, and check titles, metas, H1s, canonicals, schema, and sitemap hygiene



Verify site copy against each client's canonical fact sheet in our brand repository (services, hours, phone numbers, credentials, service-area claims) and flag every contradiction



Do visual/brand conformance passes against each client's documented brand guide: background and section colors, typography, spacing, contrast, minimum text size, mobile rendering



Compile findings into our standard format (severity, URL, exact quote/screenshot, issue, suggested fix) in CSV/GitHub/Notion — organized so template-level fixes are identified as one item, not fifty



Fixing (remediation):



Work prioritized findings lists (yours or ours) and close items in fix-order: template-level one-shot fixes first, then page-level edits



D
 the correct fix level — global template/theme, Elementor template, reusable widget, or individual page — so one edit fixes every instance



Execute bulk copy corrections safely: staging first, full backup, WP-CLI wp search-replace with dry runs, aware that Elementor stores content as JSON-escaped strings in postmeta



Verify every fix on the live page (fresh, uncached) and mark it done with a before/after note; regenerate Elementor CSS and purge caches as needed



Flag judgment calls instead of guessing — e.g., when a "wrong" fact might describe the industry generically rather than the client, or when two pages contradict each other and the client must d
 which is true



Never alter established brand elements (colors, typography, photography) except to restore them to the documented standard



Maintain redirect maps and update internal links at the source rather than stacking redirects



Log all work in our systems (GitHub, Notion) with clear, reviewable change notes



Required Skills & Experience

3+ years hands-on WordPress experience, including deep Elementor fluency: global templates vs. page-level widgets, theme builder parts (header/footer), reusable sections, custom CSS placement, CSS regeneration



Comfortable with WP-CLI (search-replace with dry-run, db export) and staging → production workflows; understands serialized/JSON data risks in bulk replacements



Working knowledge of technical SEO: meta tags, canonicals, robots directives, XML sitemaps, JSON-LD schema (able to find and fix a parse error), Rank Math or Yoast



Solid HTML/CSS (able to trace which stylesheet or widget sets a background color and override it in the right place, not with !important patches)



Meticulous written English — you catch typos other people miss, and your change notes are precise



Able to run site audits independently with tools like Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, or equivalent scripts — link status, metadata, crawl comparison — and turn raw output into a clean, prioritized findings list



Process discipline: backups before bulk edits, dry runs, verification, documentation — every time



Strongly Preferred

Experience with healthcare, behavioral-health, or other YMYL websites (accuracy and compliance sensitivity; adults-only service boundaries; no invented clinical claims)



Familiarity with GitHub-based content workflows (branches, PRs, review comments)



Experience with call tracking (CallTrackingMetrics) and GA4 — enough to know why replacing a tracked phone number with an untracked one is a serious error



Comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate QA passes — paired with the judgment to verify everything before publishing



Basic accessibility (WCAG) literacy



Cloudflare / caching stack familiarity (knowing the difference between "fixed" and "fixed but cached")



What Success Looks Like

30 days: the current backlog's template-level and high-severity items are closed and verified; zero regressions



60 days: full findings list for the first site closed; you've completed your first cold-start audit of a second site (found the issues yourself) and built a reusable audit + fix-verification checklist



90 days: you run the full find-and-fix cycle across multiple client sites independently, catch issues before clients report them, and flag client-decision items with clear framing



What We Are NOT Looking For

Redesigners — the brands' colors, typography, and photography are fixed; your job includes restoring them, not reinventing them



"It works on my machine" fixers — every fix is verified on the live, uncached page



Bulk find-replace cowboys — anyone who runs a production-wide search-replace without a dry run and backup is an immediate mismatch



Hiring Process

Application with 2–3 short examples of QA/remediation work you've done (before/after screenshots or descriptions are fine)



Paid trial task (~2 hrs): we give you a staging site with ~10 seeded errors from the categories above. You find them, document them in our findings format, fix what's safe, flag what needs a decision, and note anything you couldn't fix and why



Contract start with a real, prioritized findings list from day one
