title: YT VIDEO EDITOR, LONG-FORM HISTORY DOC (FACELESS)
description:
Pay: 30 USD per finished video.

Video length: 15 to 25 minutes.

Type: paid per video. Ongoing work for the right editor.

AI usage: minimal



THE WORK

A history documentary channel about England in the early 1800s. The videos are made to feel like an old book: warm colours, old paper, period paintings and engravings. Nothing moves fast and nothing is shiny.



We send you the script, the narration, the music, you research images/b-rolls/etc, and we also provide a style guide with the colors, the fonts, the text box sizes and the export settings. You build the video from there: choose and place the pictures, build the text plates, set the movement and the music levels, and check your own work before you send it.



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

We work with you, not just at the end of the job. We are on Slack every day, we answer questions fast, and we send more material whenever you need it. First versions get real notes, and we talk them through.



What we cannot do is direct you cut by cut or be your quality checker. We want an editor who reads the guide, understands the style, double-checks its own work before sending to the client and delivers a good first version on their own (we work together from there, we understand there is a learning curve).



AI usage

Real images before generated ones. We do use generated images, but only to fill what cannot be found, and they have to match the period so a viewer does not see the difference.



HOW WE HIRE

Phase 1. We read your application and your portfolio. Send a link to one long-form video you edited yourself (bonus if it's faceless doc-style videos).



Phase 2. If you are shortlisted, we send you a short piece of script with a reference and ask for a sample of 40-60 seconds. Small test, not paid yet, and you may put your watermark on it (do what you want if you feel like we would use it for something). This is important, because anyone can put files in an YouTube folder or on a Canva site and claim they did it. Plus we want evaluate how detail oriented you are :-)



If the sample is right, you get your first paid video, and steady work after that.

title: Account Manager / Print Estimator – UK Printing Company
description:
# Account Manager / Print Estimator – UK Printing Company



**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | UK Working Hours**



## About Us



Swytch Graphics is a UK-based commercial printing and visual communications company specialising in **large-format digital print, retail displays, point-of-sale (POS), signage, graphics and fabricated display products**.



We work predominantly with businesses, agencies, retailers and display companies, producing everything from printed boards, posters and window graphics through to retail displays, cosmetic fascias, acrylic products, lightboxes and large-format graphics.



Our production facility in Leicester, UK, operates a wide range of modern printing and finishing equipment including flatbed and roll-to-roll UV printers, digital cutting tables, laser cutters and other specialist finishing equipment.



We are continuing to grow and are now looking for an experienced and highly organised **Account Manager / Estimator based in the Philippines** to become part of our UK customer services and estimating team.



## The Role



This is **not a cold-calling or sales prospecting position**.



Your role will be to help manage existing customers and incoming enquiries, understand what the customer needs, prepare quotations and help progress work from initial enquiry through to production.



You will communicate directly with UK customers by
 and, once confident, potentially by telephone or Teams.



A typical enquiry might be:



* 500 printed retail display panels

* 2,000 point-of-sale graphics for stores

* Printed and CNC-cut Foamex boards

* Acrylic cosmetic display components

* Window vinyls and self-adhesive graphics

* Large-format banners and display graphics

* Printed PETG or polycarbonate components

* Retail lightboxes or fabric graphics

* Bespoke printed and fabricated display products



You will need to understand how a product should be manufactured and then use our estimating system to calculate the price.



## Key Responsibilities



You will:



* Respond to incoming customer enquiries

* Read and understand customer specifications and briefs

* Review dimensions, quantities, materials and finishing requirements

* Prepare accurate quotations using our MIS/estimating system

* D
 the most appropriate production method for each job

* Calculate material requirements and production processes

* Request additional information from customers when a specification is incomplete

* Prepare clear and professional quotations

* Follow up outstanding quotations where appropriate

* Convert successful quotations into production jobs

* Work closely with our UK account management and production teams

* Check artwork and job information is complete before production

* Help customers identify more economical or practical ways of producing projects

* Maintain accurate customer and project information

* Develop strong relationships with regular customers



As your technical knowledge develops, we want you to become capable of managing your own portfolio of customers and enquiries.



## Who We Are Looking For



The most important requirement is **commercial printing or signage industry experience**.



Ideally, you will already have worked for a:



* Commercial printer

* Large-format printing company

* Signage company

* Display / exhibition company

* Packaging or POS manufacturer

* Print estimating company



Previous experience estimating print jobs would be particularly valuable.



You should understand at least some of the following:



* Large-format digital printing

* Flatbed printing

* Roll-to-roll printing

* Vinyl printing

* Laminating

* Mounting

* CNC cutting

* Laser cutting

* Routing

* Acrylic fabrication

* Foamex / PVC board

* Correx / corrugated plastic

* Dibond / aluminium composite

* PETG

* Self-adhesive vinyl

* Posters and display graphics

* Retail POS / point-of-sale displays



You do **not** need to know everything on this list. We have an experienced UK team who can provide training on our equipment, materials, processes and estimating system.



However, previous print industry knowledge will make a significant difference.



## Systems



We use **PrintIQ** as our Management Information System and estimating platform.



Previous PrintIQ experience would be extremely useful but is **not essential**.



Experience with other print MIS or estimating systems such as Tharstern, Optimus, EFI Pace, PrintSmith, Avanti, Clarity or similar would also be relevant.



You should also be confident using:



* Microsoft Outlook

* Excel

* Microsoft Teams

* Web-based business software



## Your English Must Be Excellent



You will communicate directly with UK customers, so you must have:



* Excellent written English

* Strong spoken English

* Good grammar and attention to detail

* Confidence communicating professionally with customers

* The ability to understand sometimes complex written specifications



You must also be comfortable asking questions. We would much rather you ask for clarification than make assumptions when preparing a quotation.



## The Type of Person We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



* Intelligent and quick to learn

* Technically minded

* Extremely organised

* Comfortable working with numbers

* Accurate and detail-focused

* Commercially aware

* Confident communicating with customers

* Able to manage multiple enquiries at the same time

* Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

* Interested in building a long-term career with our company



This is an important position within our business and we are looking for someone who wants to become a genuine member of our team rather than simply complete outsourced tasks.



## Working Hours



This is a **full-time remote position working alongside our UK team**.



You will therefore need to work predominantly **UK business hours**.



Our normal UK office hours are approximately:



**8:00am – 5:00pm UK time, Monday to Friday**



We can discuss the exact working pattern with the successful candidate.



## Training



We appreciate that every printing company works differently.



Full training will therefore be provided covering:



* Our products

* Materials

* Printing equipment

* Finishing processes

* Production methods

* PrintIQ

* Our estimating procedures

* Our customer base



We expect the successful candidate's technical knowledge and responsibilities to increase considerably over time.



## Career Opportunity



We are looking for somebody **long term**.



Our business is growing and this position has the opportunity to develop into a senior offshore account management / estimating role as we expand the team.



For the right person, we want this to become a career rather than a short-term freelance position.



## How to Apply



When applying, please tell us:



1. What experience you have within the **printing, signage, POS or display industry**

2. Whether you have previously prepared **print estimates or quotations**

3. Which printing processes and materials you are familiar with

4. Which MIS / estimating systems you have previously used

5. Your current employment situation

6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

7. Whether you are comfortable working UK business hours



Please also start your application with the words:



**“PRINT ESTIMATOR”**



This simply confirms that you have read the full job description.



We are particularly interested in applicants with genuine print industry experience, so please explain your experience in detail.



**Job Type:** Part time to start moving to Full-Time, Permanent Remote Position

**Location:** Remote

**Industry:** Commercial Printing / Large Format Print / Retail POS & Displays

title: B2B SaaS Appointment Setter / SDR, US Market
description:
About the Role



We are an early-stage B2B SaaS/AI startup looking for an experienced outbound SDR / appointment setter to help us generate qualified meetings with decision-makers at U.S. companies.



This is NOT a basic virtual assistant or data-entry position.



We are looking for someone who has real experience running B2B outbound and understands how to turn targeted prospects into conversations and qualified meetings.



Your primary objective is simple: book qualified sales meetings.



We care much more about results than activity metrics.



What You'll Be Doing



• Research and validate target accounts and prospects

• Identify the right decision-makers within companies

• Understand why an account may be a good prospect before reaching out

• Personalize outreach based on the company, prospect, and relevant buying signals

• Conduct outbound primarily through
 and LinkedIn

• Use additional channels, including calls, when appropriate

• Consistently follow up with prospects

• Respond to interested prospects and handle basic questions or objections

• Qualify prospects before scheduling meetings

• Book qualified meetings directly onto our team's calendar

• Maintain accurate prospect and outreach information in our CRM

• Re-engage previous prospects and opportunities

• Test different messaging, channels, and approaches

• Share what you're learning and suggest ways to improve our outbound process



We already have prospecting tools, target customer criteria, lead data, and systems available. Your job is not to build everything from scratch.



Who We're Looking For



You should have:



• 2+ years of B2B outbound sales, SDR, business development, or appointment-setting experience

• Experience generating meetings with U.S.-based companies

• Experience with personalized B2B outbound, not just mass outreach

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong LinkedIn and cold
 outreach experience

• Strong research and prospecting skills

• Experience communicating with managers, directors, VPs, or other business decision-makers

• Strong follow-up habits

• Familiarity with CRMs and outbound sales tools

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of results



B2B SaaS or technology outbound experience is strongly preferred.



Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar platforms is a plus.



Cold calling experience is also a plus, but this is not a high-volume cold calling position.



What Success Looks Like



We are not hiring someone simply to send a certain number of messages every day.



Your primary performance metric will be qualified meetings that actually take place.



We want someone who thinks critically about outbound. If an approach isn't working, we want you to recognize it, suggest changes, and test something better.



The ideal person has enough outbound experience that they can bring ideas and best practices to our team, rather than needing to be taught the basics of B2B prospecting.



Schedule



Approximately 20 hours per week to start.



Some overlap with U.S. business hours is preferred.



There is potential for additional hours and responsibility if the initial engagement performs well.



Compensation



$6-$9 USD/hour depending on experience + performance-based bonuses for qualified meetings and results.



How to Apply



Please answer the following:



How many years of B2B outbound/SDR experience do you have, and what types of companies or products have you worked with?

Approximately how many qualified meetings were you personally responsible for generating per month?

Which outbound tools have you used?

(HubSpot, Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)

Please include a short voice recording introducing yourself and describing your B2B outbound experience.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "EIGHTBALL OUTBOUND" so we know you read the full posting. Applications that don't follow this instruction will not be considered.

description:

That's where you come in.



You will help translate business ideas into technical solutions, make engineering decisions, build products, deploy them, and continuously improve them.



This is not a traditional junior developer position.



We are open to engineers early in their careers who have demonstrated exceptional initiative through **personal projects, freelance work, internships, startup experience, open-source contributions, or applications they have built independently.**



We care more about what you can build and how you think than the number of years you've worked.







 What You'll Be Doing

Idea → Plan → Design → Code → Test → Deploy → Improve**

* Turning business requirements into technical requirements

* Building modern web applications

 What We Mean by "Founding Engineer"



We don't expect you to know everything.



We expect you to be able to figure things out

"We need businesses to be able to create profiles, customers need to search those businesses, companies should be able to purchase premium listings, and we want AI-generated content for the profiles."

Then you'll explain your recommendations to the founder in clear, understandable language and build the solution.







Technology You'll Work With

 Frontend

 AI

is a strong plus.

---



Cloud & Deployment

SEO & Web Performance

Experience with:



* Technical SEO

* Dynamic metadata

* 

* XML sitemaps

* Robots.txt

* Canonical URLs

* Internal linking

* Core Web Vitals

* Page performance

* Programmatic SEO



is a major advantage.







The Person We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is:



Curious



You enjoy learning technologies you haven't used before.



Independent



You don't need someone standing over you telling you what to do every hour.



Resourceful



When you encounter a problem, your first instinct is to investigate, research, test, and find a solution.



Practical



You understand that the best technical solution isn't always the most complicated one.



Accountable



You take ownership of your work and the results.



 A Strong Communicator



You can explain technical decisions to someone who isn't an engineer.



Product-Minded



You care about whether the product actually solves the customer's problem—not just whether the code works.



AI-Curious



You understand that AI is changing how software is built and you're excited to learn how to use it effectively.







You Don't Need to Know Everything



If you don't know AWS, that's okay.



If you've never used a vector database, that's okay.



If you've never built a payment system, that's okay.



If you've never worked with Next.js, that's okay.



What matters is whether you can say:



I haven't done that before, but I can learn it.



We want someone who can research documentation, experiment, build prototypes, ask good questions, and eventually own the solution.







What We Consider a Strong Candidate



You may be a great fit if you have:



* 0–3+ years of professional experience

* A computer science or related degree **or equivalent practical experience**

* Strong programming fundamentals

* Experience with React or another modern frontend framework

* Backend/API experience

* SQL/database experience

* Git/GitHub experience

* At least one meaningful project you've built

* Experience deploying an application

* Strong problem-solving ability



 Even better:



You've independently built something such as:



* A SaaS application

* AI application

* Marketplace

* Business directory

* E-commerce platform

* Mobile application

* Automation tool

* Chrome extension

* Internal business application

* Open-source project



Show us what you've built.



That's more important to us than having a perfect resume.







 We Encourage Non-Traditional Candidates



You do not need a perfect career history to apply.



We are interested in:



* Recent graduates

* Self-taught developers

* Bootcamp graduates

* Freelance developers

* Startup engineers

* Developers with strong personal projects

* Engineers transitioning into software development

* Open-source contributors

* People who have built products independently



If you can demonstrate that you can **learn, build, solve problems, and take ownership**, we want to hear from you.







What Success Looks Like



After joining the company, we want you to eventually be able to receive a business objective and turn it into a working product.



For example:



Founder:



 "Customers need a better way to find and compare companies."



You:



"Here's how I recommend we build it."



Then you:



Design → Build → Test → Deploy → Measure → Improve



That's the level of ownership we're building toward.







How We'll Evaluate You



We don't believe resumes tell the whole story.



Our hiring process may include:



1. Introductory Interview



We'll learn about you, your interests, and what you've built.



2. Technical Conversation



We'll discuss real engineering problems rather than simply asking trivia questions.



 3. Project Review



We'll ask you to walk us through something you've built.



We want to understand:



* What did you build?

* Why did you build it?

* What technology did you choose?

* What problems did you encounter?

* How did you solve them?

* What would you change?



4. Practical Technical Exercise



You may be asked to build a small application or feature.



The goal isn't to trick you.



We want to see how you:



Think → Plan → Build → Debug → Explain



5. Final Founder Interview



You'll meet directly with the founder and discuss the company's vision and the role you'll play in building it.







Important: AI Is Allowed



We don't expect candidates to pretend AI doesn't exist.



Modern engineers use tools such as AI coding assistants, LLMs, documentation tools, and automated development tools.



We care about whether you understand the code you produce



Using AI to increase productivity is encouraged.



Submitting AI-generated code you don't understand is not.







 Why Join Us?



This role offers something that is difficult to find early in a software engineering career:



 Real ownership.



You won't simply be one developer among hundreds working on a tiny piece of a massive system.



You'll have the opportunity to:



* Build products from scratch

* Work directly with the founder

* Influence technical decisions

* Work with AI

* Learn full-stack development

* Work across frontend and backend

* Deploy real applications

* See your work used by customers

* Develop product and business judgment

* Grow rapidly as an engineer



If you want to spend the next few years simply completing assigned tickets, this may not be the right role.



If you want to build things, solve difficult problems, learn quickly, and have a meaningful role in a growing company, we want to meet you.







The Bottom Line



We are looking for an engineer who doesn't say:



Tell me exactly what to code.



We are looking for someone who says:



Tell me what problem we're trying to solve, and I'll figure out how to build it



If that's you, Apply



 When applying, please include:



1. Your resume

2. GitHub or portfolio, if available

3. One project you're particularly proud of

4. A brief explanation of what you personally built

5. Links to any live applications you've deployed



We care more about what you've built than how many years you've been employed.

title: TikTok Creator Business Development Specialist (BD)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a results-driven TikTok Creator Business Development Specialist who understands the TikTok Shop ecosystem and excels at creator outreach, relationship building, and partnership conversion.

This is not a traditional BD role focused solely on creator sourcing and contract negotiation. You will support creators throughout the full partnership lifecycle—from discovery, screening, outreach, and onboarding to post-signing development, campaign matching, sample fulfillment, and long-term relationship management.

You will work closely with creators to understand their content niches, LIVE capabilities, product interests, and growth goals. Through product and campaign opportunities, samples, training, one-on-one coaching, and practical content recommendations, you will help creators become more active, improve their commercial performance, and build sustainable partnerships with our agency.

The ideal candidate combines a strong sense of ownership and commercial awareness with the patience and communication skills needed to build genuine, long-term creator relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Sourcing and Outreach

- Identify and recruit suitable TikTok Shop creators in the U.S. market through TikTok, creator databases, social media, referrals, and other relevant channels.

- Evaluate creators based on content quality, niche, audience profile, engagement, sales potential, LIVE experience, and overall partnership fit.

- Build and maintain a healthy creator pipeline, from initial outreach through onboarding and long-term collaboration.

- Develop personalized outreach strategies and communicate with creators through
, Lark, TikTok Shop, and other approved channels.

- Follow up consistently and move qualified creators from initial contact to active partnership.

Partnership Development and Onboarding

- Clearly communicate the agency’s partnership model, creator support, expectations, and collaboration process.

- Understand each creator’s needs, concerns, working style, and commercial goals.

- Address common questions and objections professionally while avoiding unrealistic promises regarding samples, traffic, sales, or income.

- Support creators throughout the onboarding and signing process.

- Maintain accurate records of creator status, conversations, follow-up actions, and next steps.

Post-Signing Creator Development

- Build ongoing relationships with signed creators and maintain regular, meaningful communication.

- Learn each creator’s main category, preferred content format, LIVE frequency, product interests, and development goals.

- Help creators identify suitable products, campaigns, sample opportunities, and content directions.

- Coordinate one-on-one account reviews, content feedback, training sessions, workshops, and other creator development initiatives.

- Encourage consistent participation, content creation, LIVE activity, and campaign engagement.

Campaign and Product Matching

- Match creators with suitable TikTok Shop products and campaigns based on their niche, audience, content style, and performance.

- Share relevant product and sample opportunities in a clear and compelling way.

- Verify current campaign requirements, product availability, commission terms, and sample conditions before communicating them to creators.

- Work with internal teams to support creator applications, campaign participation, and partnership execution.

- Track creator interest, applications, approvals, and participation status.

Sample Fulfillment and Performance Follow-Up

- Coordinate sample requests and follow up on approval, shipping, delivery, and content fulfillment.

- Remind creators of pending deliverables in a professional and supportive manner.

- Identify delays, communication issues, or fulfillment risks and escalate them when necessary.

- Follow up on published videos and LIVE activity, and provide practical feedback based on available performance data.

- Help creators improve content quality, product demonstrations, presentation, and conversion potential.

Relationship Management and Internal Collaboration

- Maintain positive, professional, and long-term relationships with creators.

- Respond to creator questions promptly and coordinate with internal teams when additional support or verification is required.

- Collaborate with Creator Operations, Campaign, Brand Partnership, and Project teams.

- Keep creator records, follow-up notes, campaign status, and action items accurate and up to date.

- Share recurring creator questions, challenges, and market feedback to help improve internal processes and creator support.

Qualifications

- Experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, business development, affiliate marketing, social commerce, or creator operations.

- Good understanding of TikTok, TikTok Shop, short-form video, livestream commerce, and the U.S. creator ecosystem.

- Strong communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and follow-up skills.

- Ability to manage multiple creators, conversations, campaigns, and deadlines simultaneously.

- Strong ownership and the ability to move opportunities forward without constant supervision.

- Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable maintaining accurate tracking records.

- Able to evaluate creator potential using both quantitative data and qualitative judgment.

- Professional working proficiency in English.

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where campaign details and priorities may change.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience working with TikTok Shop creators, MCNs, agencies, brands, or affiliate programs.

- Experience recruiting and supporting both short-video and LIVE creators.

- Familiarity with creator outreach tools, CRM systems, spreadsheets, or creator-management platforms.

- Understanding of sample fulfillment, campaign coordination, and creator performance tracking.

- Spanish proficiency is a strong plus, as we work with both English-speaking and Spanish-speaking creators in the U.S. market.

- Existing relationships within the U.S. TikTok Shop creator community are a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured only by the number of creators contacted or signed. We will also evaluate:

- The quality and relevance of creators added to the pipeline.

- Outreach response and partnership conversion rates.

- The number of creators who complete onboarding and become active.

- Creator participation in campaigns, samples, short-form videos, and LIVE opportunities.

- Sample and content fulfillment rates.

- Creator retention, responsiveness, and long-term engagement.

- The accuracy and timeliness of creator records and follow-ups.

- The ability to identify high-potential creators and help them grow into reliable long-term partners.

Who We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Enjoy talking with creators and building relationships—not just sending mass outreach.

- Know how to follow up consistently without making the conversation feel transactional.

- Can balance creator needs with campaign requirements and business goals.

- Are comfortable using data while still recognizing creative potential.

- Take initiative, solve problems, and keep projects moving.

- Want to help creators grow from initial contact into active, long-term commercial partners.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter (SDR) | Remote | US Hours | $480 Base + Commission
description:
NOTE: WE’RE LOOKING TO HIRE FOR MONDAY THE 31ST IMMEDIATE START. FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS.



We’re hiring 3-4 experienced cold callers and appointment setters to book qualified appointments with US local business owners (we can hire you from anywhere).



This is a full-time, high-volume outbound role. We provide the leads, parallel power dialer, CRM, scripts, offer, training and complete sales system.



Your job is to call business owners, create interest, lightly qualify them and book them into meetings with our closing team. You are not responsible for closing sales.



WHAT WE SELL



We help local businesses install high-performance websites and complete digital infrastructure, including:



* High-performance websites

* SEO and Google review systems

* CRM systems

* AI chatbots and AI receptionists

* Paid advertising



You do not need to explain or sell every service during the cold call. Your objective is to generate interest, confirm basic qualification and book the owner into a sales presentation (with a script we give you).



IMPORTANT CONTEXT



This is not an untested startup being built from scratch.



You will be working within an established agency operation currently producing approximately $100,000-$300,000 USD per month in sales, using proven scripts, presentations, CRM systems, sales processes and operating infrastructure.



The offer uses relatively light qualification, allowing strong callers to generate a high volume of appointments. For experienced setters who follow the system, approximately 10 meetings per day is a realistic minimum performance target.



WORKING SCHEDULE



* Monday to Friday

* 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time

* 8 hours per day

* Most Saturdays will include approximately 4 hours of training, roleplay, coaching or call reviews

* You must be able to consistently work US Central Time, including seasonal daylight-saving changes



Depending on your country, this may require evening, overnight or early-morning work. Do not apply unless you can reliably maintain this schedule long term.



COMPENSATION



* $480 USD monthly performance-based base salary

* Approximately $480–$960 USD in additional monthly commission

* Approximately $960–$1,440 USD total OTE monthly target earnings

* Progression into TL / other roles may eventually be possible



The full base salary is dependent on consistently meeting the position’s minimum performance standards, and will not be paid if these quotas are not hit (100% of our current team can meet them daily). We will give you a few days / a week to ramp, then this will become active.



* Minimum standard: 10 qualified meetings per day

* Target performance: approximately 12-15 qualified meetings per day

* Strong performance above target creates greater commission potential (on top of the $960-$1,440 ceiling)



These figures are projections, not guaranteed earnings (outside of base). Actual earnings depend on attendance, booking volume, appointment quality, qualification, show rate and closed sales.



If your appointments consistently produce revenue, we want that reflected in what you earn.



ENGLISH AND COMMUNICATION STANDARD



This is a customer-facing position speaking directly with US business owners.



Your spoken English and accent must be near-indistinguishable from that of a native English speaker.



You must be:



* Natural, confident and conversational

* Extremely comfortable speaking English and charismatic

* Easy for US business owners to understand immediately

* Able to maintain strong conversational flow, pacing and control

* Able to respond naturally without sounding scripted

* Comfortable handling objections in real time (we provide this)

* Free from frequent grammatical errors, long pauses or hesitation



Being technically understandable is not enough for this position. You must be able to hold fast-moving conversations with American business owners while sounding relaxed, credible and natural.



We are not looking for people who apply because “just in case they accept me” or people who say “trust me, I don’t have experience but I can do this” only people who fit this post’s requirements.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



* More than 3 months of cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Experience speaking directly with business owners or decision-makers

* Previous booking numbers, KPIs, call recordings or another form of proof (something)

* Experience making a high volume of outbound calls

* Confidence handling objections and rejection

* Familiarity with CRM systems and appointment booking

* The ability to follow a proven script while still sounding natural



Applicants with 3 months of experience or less will not be considered.



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* A reliable computer

* A professional-quality headset

* Fast and stable internet

* A quiet working environment

* Reliable electricity or a backup solution

* Strong attendance and punctuality

* The ability to make hundreds of dials per day (minimum is 150 conversations a day)

* A coachable attitude

* The ability to follow instructions and apply feedback quickly

* A genuine interest in developing into a long-term, high-performing SDR



No manual lead sourcing is required. We provide the business database, dialing infrastructure, CRM, scripts and training.



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED MEETING?



A qualified meeting must be booked with the actual business owner or an authorized decision-maker.



The attendee must be genuinely capable of making a purchasing decision. An office manager, employee or owner who cannot proceed without approval from a boss, spouse, business partner or another decision-maker would not normally count unless the additional decision-maker also attends.



Appointments must be entered accurately into the CRM and meet the qualification standards covered during training.



TRIAL PERIOD



Successful applicants will complete an initial one-week trial.



During the trial, we will assess:



* Attendance and reliability

* Dial volume

* Spoken English and conversational flow

* Script execution

* Objection handling

* Appointment volume

* Qualification accuracy

* CRM accuracy

* Coachability

* Ability to apply feedback



At the end of the week, we will review performance together and determine whether both sides would like to continue. You will get paid regardless of course.



Payment can be made through Wise. You can use anyone’s Wise account. We will actively prefer applicants who have or can get Wise, if not, your application will be less likely to be approved. Exact payment frequency, commission structure and trial compensation will be confirmed before starting.



TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your full name, country and time zone

2. Your cold-calling and appointment-setting experience

3. Confirmation that you have more than 3 months of relevant experience

4. The industries and offers you have previously called for

5. Your previous daily or weekly booking numbers and KPIs

6. A 60-second voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself (No recording = no consideration)

7. Confirmation that you can work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday

8. Confirmation that you can attend four-hour Saturday training sessions

9. Details of your computer, headset and internet connection

10. Why you believe you would perform well in a high-volume, performance-driven role



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small roleplay and interview.



Expected hiring timeline: WE ARE LOOKING TO BRING PEOPLE ON FOR MONDAY THE 31ST



NOTE: You must be very responsive and professional. If you are unpunctual, show up late, can’t keep your camera on during interviews, etc, you will be kicked.

s

title: Shopify Store Builder and Creative Strategist
description:
About the role:



We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer Shopify brands. We build new stores, test products, and scale the winners with paid ads on Meta.



Your primary job is building Shopify stores. When we have a store in the queue, that's what you're working on, and we expect them built fast and built well. Between builds — and there will be real stretches between them — you shift to our second priority: static creative. Ad images that run on Meta, and on-site graphics that make our product pages look like real brands instead of dropshipping stores.



On the creative side, we want an owner, not a pair of hands. We'll give you the product, the market research, the customer angles, and examples of what's worked before. From there we expect you to do your own research into what's currently winning in the category, decide what's worth testing, and hand back finished creatives. If you need a detailed spec for every asset, this isn't the right role. If you already spend time in the Meta Ad Library because you find it interesting, keep reading.



So: a builder first, a designer second, and someone who can switch between the two without losing a day to context switching.



What you'll do:



Shopify store building (primary):



Build and launch new stores from a theme: home page, product pages, collection pages, policy pages, and the full navigation.

Install and configure apps (bundles, cart drawer, upsells, reviews,
) following our documented setup.

Set up product listings: variants, pricing, images, descriptions, SEO fields, and inventory settings.

Make sure every page looks correct on mobile first, then desktop. Most of our traffic is mobile.

Clone and adapt proven page layouts across new stores instead of reinventing each one. Speed comes from reuse.

Maintain live stores: fix broken sections, spacing problems, slow-loading images, misaligned buttons.

Keep our build process documented so each store goes faster than the last.



Static creative (between builds):



Design ad creatives for Meta in 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16 using our brand templates and safe-zone guidelines.

Research what's working right now in our categories: competitor ads, adjacent niches, ad libraries, TikTok and Instagram creative trends. Keep an organized swipe file we can all use.

Bring us new static concepts with a one-line rationale for each — new angles, new hooks, new formats.

Iterate on winners: when an ad performs, produce the variations that extend its life (new hook, new headline, new background, same winning structure).



Create on-site graphics: comparison charts, benefit icon rows, "how it works" strips, guarantee badges, review and testimonial cards, bundle graphics, size and spec charts.



Retouch and clean up supplier product photos — remove backgrounds, fix lighting, composite products into lifestyle scenes.

Organize every asset in our shared Drive with a consistent naming convention so we can trace which creative won.



Requirements:

Must have:



2+ years building Shopify stores. You know the theme editor cold and have shipped stores end to end, not just edited someone else's.

You're fast. Tell us honestly how long a full store build takes you from empty theme to launch-ready.

2+ years designing static ads for ecommerce — direct response, not brand or social content. You understand that an ad's job is to stop the scroll and sell, and your work shows it.

You can look at an ad and explain why it works: the angle, the hook, the visual hierarchy, the offer. We will ask you to do this in the interview.

A working habit of researching creative on your own — ad libraries, competitor tracking, saving what you see.

Fluent in Canva and at least one of Photoshop, Figma, or Illustrator.

You already use AI tools daily — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — and you're good at it. We use AI throughout our operation: product research, ad copy, page copy, image generation and editing, troubleshooting Shopify issues, and speeding up repetitive work. We expect you to reach for these tools on your own, not wait to be told. Be ready to tell us specifically how you use them and where they save you time.

Solid written English. You'll be pitching creative ideas in writing, not just receiving instructions.

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle design work without crashing.

Genuinely self-directed. You plan your own week and report progress without being chased.



Nice to have:



Basic HTML/CSS for small theme tweaks.

Experience with page builders (GemPages, PageFly, Replo, Shogun).

Familiarity with conversion apps: bundle widgets, cart drawers, post-purchase upsells, review apps.

Experience running or managing Meta ads yourself, even at small scale.

Copywriting for ads — headlines, hooks, overlay text.

AI image generation and editing for creative work (Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Photoshop generative fill, or similar).

Basic video editing or motion (a plus, not required — we have a separate editor).



Tools you'll use:

Shopify, Canva, Photoshop or Figma, Claude and ChatGPT, AI image tools, Meta Ad Library, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack or WhatsApp, Loom, and a handful of Shopify apps we'll train you on.



What it's like working with us:

We give you the product, the research, and the goal — then get out of your way.

Fast feedback and no ambiguity about what "done" means.

We're direct. If something isn't working we'll tell you plainly, and we expect the same back. If you think one of our ideas is weak, say so.

Reliable pay, on schedule, every time.

Long-term role. If you're good, your scope and rate grow — we'd rather raise one strong person than cycle through five cheap ones.



How to apply:

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be read.



1. Put "BEESWAX" as the first word of your application so we know you read this.

2. Send a portfolio link with at least 3 Shopify stores you built (live URLs) and at least 5 static ads you designed for ecommerce brands. Tell us specifically what you did on each.



Answer these questions:

1. How long does a full store build take you, from empty theme to ready to launch? Walk us through your process briefly.

2. Go to the Meta Ad Library, pick any direct-to-consumer product you find interesting, and find one static ad you think is performing well. Send us the screenshot and 3–4 sentences on why you think it works.

3. Where do you look for creative inspiration and competitor research? Name the actual sources you use.

4. Which AI tools do you use in your day-to-day work, and give us one concrete example of a task you've made faster with them. Generic answers ("I use ChatGPT for content") tell us nothing.

5.Which are you stronger at — store building or creative? Be honest.

Tell us your hours in PHT, and your monthly rate for full-time work.



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test project: build one product page from a reference, and — given a product and our market research — come back with three ad angles you'd test plus two finished statics. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.

title: AI Video Creator / Editor for TikTok, Instagram Reels & Facebook Ads
description:
We are looking for a talented AI Video Creator & Short-Form Video Editor to create scroll-stopping videos for a U.S.-based business.



Our company, EZ Holiday Lighting, helps roofing companies, landscapers, pressure washers, gutter companies and other home-service contractors add professional Christmas-light installation to their existing businesses.



We will provide the scripts, messaging, branding and creative direction.



Your job is to turn those ideas into high-quality, realistic AI videos that look like professional advertisements — NOT cheap or obviously AI-generated content.



The videos will primarily be used on:



TikTok

Instagram Reels


/Instagram Ads

YouTube Shorts

What You Will Create



Most videos will be approximately 15–45 seconds and vertical 9:16.



Examples might include:



Video #1: Roofing crews working during summer → winter arrives → same trucks and crews professionally installing Christmas lights → beautiful finished luxury home.



Video #2: Contractor trucks sitting unused during the slow season → transition into crews installing holiday lighting → headline: “YOUR TRUCKS DON'T HAVE TO HIBERNATE.”



Video #3: Cinematic drone view of an upscale American neighborhood covered in Christmas lights → EZ Holiday Lighting truck arrives → crews installing lights → “Someone is going to get these jobs. Why not your company?”



Video #4: Contractor standing beside trucks and ladders → visuals identify trucks, crews, equipment and existing customers → “YOU ALREADY HAVE THE EXPENSIVE PART.”



We want videos that make contractors stop scrolling and watch.



Skills We're Looking For



You should have experience with some combination of:



Google Veo / Veo 3

Kling AI

Runway

Sora

Higgsfield

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

CapCut

Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects



You do NOT need to know every platform.



We care more about whether you can produce realistic, cinematic, professional-looking AI video.



Current AI-video hiring posts on OnlineJobs.ph similarly emphasize prompt engineering, realistic AI generation, short-form editing, strong hooks and understanding pacing/retention rather than knowledge of one particular tool.



VERY IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone who simply generates random AI clips and puts them together.



You need to understand:



The first 2–3 seconds are everything.



Videos need:



Strong hooks

Fast pacing

Realistic people

Realistic American homes

Realistic contractor trucks and crews

Cinematic lighting

Consistent branding

Professional captions

Sound effects/music

Smooth transitions

Clear call-to-action

Strong visual storytelling



You should also be able to keep characters, trucks, logos and branding reasonably consistent between scenes.



We Will Provide



We will provide:



Scripts and hooks

Brand logo and colors

Website

Example advertisements

Creative concepts

Messaging

Feedback



You will handle the AI generation + editing + final video production.



This Can Become Long-Term Work



We want to start with a few videos.



If your work is excellent, we have ongoing work available.



We ultimately want someone who can help us consistently produce multiple videos every week and test different:



Hooks → Visuals → Scripts → CTAs → Audiences



We operate multiple businesses, so there may also be opportunities for additional projects for the right person.

title: Talent Recruiter for Marketing Agency (Full-Time)
description:
Jeong X is a social media + monetization agency for expert, education, and news brands. We run high‑volume content machines for clients doing millions of views per month, and we need a steady stream of strong overseas talent (video editors, motion designers, social media managers) to keep up.



We’re hiring a full‑time Talent Recruiter / Sourcer whose main job is simple:

Keep our pipeline full of excellent creative candidates and move them through our audition funnel fast, so the team never has to chase or scramble for hires.



This is not an HR generalist role and not a manager role. It’s a hands‑on, high‑activity recruiting position focused on sourcing, screening, and coordinating tests/trials.



APPLY HERE: 



What you’ll do

You will own the end‑to‑end pipeline for creative roles (editors, motion designers, SMMs):

* Source candidates daily

    * Post and refresh job ads on platforms like OnlineJobs, Upwork, LinkedIn,
 groups, etc.

    * Run outbound DMs to promising profiles using our scripts.

    * Build and maintain a “bench” of pre‑qualified candidates we can tap when we need to hire.

* Run our audition funnel

    * Send applicants our application form and collect reels/portfolios.

    * Filter candidates against clear criteria and examples (style, speed, language).

    * Coordinate and schedule:

        * Take‑home tests (editing or motion tests).

        * Live working sessions (Zoom / screen share).

        * Paid trials.

* Coordinate with the team

    * Work closely with our post‑production lead and social media lead to understand upcoming headcount needs.

    * Keep them updated on candidate status, upcoming tests, and likely start dates.

    * Make sure they only see finalists, not noise.

* Track recruiting metrics

    * Keep a simple dashboard of:

        * Candidates sourced per week

        * Tests sent / completed

        * Hires made

        * Cost per successful hire

        * Time‑to‑fill for each role



Your success is measured by speed and quality of hires, not by how many meetings you sit in.



What success looks like (first 90 days)

By month 3, you:

* Have consistent pipelines for editors, motion designers, and SMMs (bench of strong candidates ready).

* Can fill a standard role (editor / SMM) from “approved headcount” to “start date” in 2–3 weeks or less.

* Are delivering candidates that pass our tests and trials at a high rate (most first hires stick).

* Have removed sourcing, screening, and scheduling from the founders’ and SMMs’ plates.



Must‑have

* Proven experience recruiting or sourcing for creative, digital, or remote roles (agency or startup experience is a plus).

* Comfortable doing high‑volume outreach and managing many candidates at once.

* Strong written English – you’ll be messaging candidates all day.

* Organized and detail‑oriented:

    * Can maintain trackers, candidate notes, and hiring stages without dropping balls.

* Fast and responsive:

    * You acknowledge messages quickly, hit deadlines, and keep everyone updated.

* Resourceful:

    * You don’t sit and wait for applicants; you go out and hunt for better talent when inbound is weak.

* Comfortable working fully remote, across time zones.



Nice to have

* Experience hiring video editors, motion designers, or social media managers.

* Experience with tools like Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets, Slack, and applicant tracking systems.

* Basic understanding of what “good” looks like in short‑form / YouTube editing or motion design (you don’t need to be an editor, but you should be able to spot obvious quality differences).

full/part time

 and Instagram leads into qualified, booked appointments.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call new and existing leads assigned to you each day

- Follow simple call scripts and handle common questions

- Qualify leads by service needed, location, timeline, budget, homeowner status, and decision-maker availability

- Book appointments on client calendars

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong, clear spoken English and a confident phone presence

- Prior cold-calling, call-center, sales, or appointment-setting experience

- Comfortable making calls throughout the workday

- Reliable attendance and ability to work during US daytime business hours

- Quiet workspace, dependable computer, good internet, and a quality headset

- Organized, coachable, honest, and able to follow a process

- GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred

- Home-services, construction, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, solar, or real-estate calling experience is a major plus



PAY AND SCHEDULE

- Full time: 40 hours per week

- Starting pay: $100 USD per week, paid weekly

- Long-term opportunity for the right person

- Selected applicants may begin with a paid trial at the same weekly rate



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. A 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself in English.

2. In the recording, give a short example of how you would open a call with a homeowner who submitted a
 form asking about a kitchen or bathroom remodel.

title: Outbound Enrollment Closer – Career Certification Programs (Remote, EST)
description:
Outbound Enrollment Closer – Career Certification Programs (Remote, EST)



This is not customer service.

This is not inbound order-taking.



This is a phone-driven, outbound enrollment closer role for professionals who know how to control a consult, qualify fast, overcome objections, and close.



We are a U.S.-based online career school enrolling students into IT and Project Management certification programs (CompTIA, PMP, and related tracks). We provide warm leads. You bring the discipline, urgency, and closing skill.



What You’ll Be Doing (Daily Reality)



Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective students



Run structured, consultative enrollment calls (needs analysis? recommendation? close)



Control the call, set next steps, and ask for the enrollment



Handle objections around price, time, confidence, and urgency



Follow up relentlessly until the prospect converts or disqualifies



Log activity and outcomes accurately in CRM



Hit daily activity targets and monthly enrollment goals



Improve close rates through coaching, scripts, and call reviews



If you don’t like calling, this role will break you.



Who This Role Is For



Proven outbound / inside sales closers



Comfortable dialing daily and living on the phone



Strong command of English with clear U.S. cultural fluency



Confident asking direct questions and pushing for decisions



Competitive, coachable, metrics-driven



Organized and accountable without supervision



Experience selling education, training, coaching, or professional services is a major plus



Familiarity with certifications (CompTIA, PMP) helps—but closing ability matters more



Bachelor’s degree required



Who Should NOT Apply



Anyone who needs inbound-only leads



Anyone uncomfortable asking for money



Anyone who avoids objection handling



Anyone who wants a “soft” admissions role



Anyone who disappears when targets tighten



Schedule



Monday–Friday



10:00 AM – 6:30 PM EST



Compensation



Base pay: $1,200–$1,600 USD per month



Performance-based advancement and leadership path



Long-term role with stability and growth for performers



(Top performers move fast. Average performers don’t last.)



What You Get



Warm leads with real intent



Clear scripts, frameworks, and coaching



No gimmicks, no fake promises—just real programs that work



A sales culture that rewards results



Bottom Line



If you can:



Control a sales conversation



Build urgency without lying



Close consistently



Take coaching and improve



You will win here.



If not—this role will expose you quickly.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive & Personal Assistant



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $2,000 USD/month

Schedule: Must have strong overlap with EST business hours



About the Role



We’re looking for a highly organized, resourceful Executive & Personal Assistant to support the CEO of Blunt Cases.



This is not a traditional administrative role where you’ll simply be given a checklist of repetitive tasks. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the day-to-day details that come with running a fast-growing company and a busy schedule.



You’ll help manage everything from calendars, travel, appointments, and personal logistics to vendor follow-ups, research, documentation, recruiting coordination, and miscellaneous business administration.



The right person is proactive, persistent, discreet, and exceptionally good at figuring things out. You should be comfortable receiving a request like “Can you handle this?” and independently determining the steps needed to get it done.



What You’ll Own



Executive & Calendar Support



- Manage and organize the CEO’s calendar

- Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate meetings

- Protect focus time and help prioritize scheduling requests

- Coordinate interviews, vendor meetings, internal calls, and external appointments

- Make sure meeting links, documents, addresses, and relevant information are organized ahead of time

- Maintain reminders for important deadlines, renewals, appointments, and follow-ups

- Help maintain an organized running list of outstanding priorities and tasks



Travel & Reservations



- Research and book flights, hotels, transportation, and other travel

- Manage itineraries, confirmations, seat selections, check-ins, and reservation details

- Make restaurant and event reservations

- Coordinate travel changes, cancellations, refunds, and credits when necessary

- Create organized itineraries containing everything needed for a trip



Business Administration



- Follow up with vendors, suppliers, agencies, contractors, and other partners

- Track outstanding requests and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

- Request invoices, receipts, contracts, W-9s, insurance certificates, licenses, and other documentation

- Organize business documents, contracts, invoices, and records

- Help track invoices, payments, renewals, subscriptions, and recurring expenses

- Contact software companies, service providers, shipping carriers, banks, or other businesses to resolve administrative issues

- Maintain trackers and spreadsheets as needed

- Pull basic reports or exports from company platforms

- Organize information and research before decisions or meetings

- Assist with basic vendor sourcing and quote collection

- Track deliveries, samples, shipments, and other outstanding business items

- Help coordinate office, studio, and company logistics



Recruiting & Team Administration



- Coordinate candidate interviews and scheduling

- Send questionnaires, interview information, and follow-ups

- Maintain candidate trackers

- Assist with contractor and employee onboarding logistics

- Organize agreements, onboarding documents, and account-access requests

- Keep track of important contractor information, start dates, and documentation



Personal & Life Administration



- Book and manage appointments

- Handle personal reservations and scheduling

- Communicate with service providers on the CEO’s behalf

- Make phone calls to resolve account, billing, reservation, or service issues

- Coordinate returns, exchanges, refunds, deliveries, and appointments

- Research and purchase products or services when requested

- Help coordinate household, apartment, wedding, and other personal logistics

- Handle miscellaneous life-admin tasks that would otherwise take time away from the CEO



What We’re Looking For



2–4 years of previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or in a similar high-trust administrative support role. Experience directly supporting a founder, executive, or business owner strongly preferred.



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong phone communication skills and confidence speaking with US-based companies

- Extremely organized and detail-oriented

- Strong follow-through and persistence

- Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently

- Able to manage multiple open tasks without losing track of them

- Good judgment and ability to understand when something requires escalation

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly

- High level of discretion and professionalism

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software

- Strong research and problem-solving skills

- Able to communicate clearly and concisely

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told every next step



Tools You May Work With



Experience with every platform is not required, but you should be comfortable learning tools such as:



- Gmail

- Google Calendar

- Google Drive

- Claude / ChatGPT

- Notion

- Slack

- Shopify

- Gusto

- Ramp

- Dropbox

- Excel / Google Sheets

- Travel and booking platforms



What Success Looks Like



You make the CEO’s life easier.



You keep track of the small things before they become big things. You follow up without being reminded. You know what is still outstanding, who owes us an answer, what deadline is approaching, and what needs attention.



When given a problem, your instinct is to investigate it, make the calls, send the
s, and come back with a solution.



Over time, the goal is for the CEO to be able to send you a message saying, “Can you handle this?” and trust that it will be handled from start to finish.

If this role sounds like a strong fit, please complete our application questionnaire below.



We review applications based on experience, communication, resourcefulness, and overall fit for the role.

title: Finance & Accounting Specialist — Xero Bookkeeping + P&L Management (Ecommerce, Digital & Physical Products)
description:
Are YOU someone who can look at a P&L and immediately spot the number that doesn't add up — not because it's flagged in red, but because you actually understand what should be there? Can you tell the difference between a simple average and a volume-weighted average, and explain in one sentence why the difference matters for a business spending real money on ads every day?



If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run an international ecommerce operation selling both digital and physical products (educational content, online courses, and physical craft kits) to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. We're looking for a Finance & Accounting Specialist to take real ownership of our bookkeeping in Xero and our profit & loss reporting — not just data entry, but someone who understands what the numbers mean.

This is not a role where you disappear for a month and hand us a spreadsheet. We need daily visibility into where the money is going and whether it's going where it should.



We need someone to take responsibility for:

-Xero Bookkeeping & Reconciliation: Own our Xero setup end-to-end — bank feed reconciliation (Airwallex, Shopify Payments, PayPal), categorization via bank rules, and monthly close. We keep our accounting deliberately lean: most recurring expenses (ad platforms, software subscriptions) are automated through bank rules, but genuine supplier invoices (physical product COGS) need to be entered and tracked properly as bills — this is the part we can't afford to get wrong.

-P&L Ownership, Not Just Reporting: Compile and maintain our profit & loss across all revenue and expense sources — Meta Ads, Google Ads, physical product supplier costs, team/contractor payments, software costs. You understand that a simple average across days with different volumes produces a misleading number, and you know how to build (or maintain) a weighted-average model instead.

-Daily Check-In, Weekly Deep Work: This role is structured as roughly 1 hour/day, every day including Saturday and Sunday — not because we expect 7 hours of heavy reconciliation work daily, but because we need a daily pulse on cash flow, ad spend, and a specific internal profit-tracking mechanism tied to one of our business units (details shared after initial screening). The deeper reconciliation and P&L update work happens in 1-2 more substantial sessions per week. We'll agree on the exact rhythm together, but daily presence is non-negotiable.

-Data Reading, Not Just Data Entry: We don't just want someone who inputs numbers correctly — we want someone who reads them. If ad spend efficiency drops, if a category of costs creeps up, if something in the P&L looks off compared to last week, we want you to flag it before we ask.

-Documentation Judgment: You understand which expenses need a formal invoice/bill (e.g., physical product suppliers) and which don't (e.g., ad platform charges captured via bank feed, contractor payments already documented through time-tracking software). You don't create unnecessary paperwork, but you never let something slip through without a proper trail either.

-Precision, Always: Correct categorization, correct currency handling across multiple payment processors, zero tolerance for reconciliation errors that go unnoticed. If a number is wrong, it should never be us who catches it first.



Position Requirements:

-Proven hands-on experience with Xero — not "I've used accounting software before," but specifically Xero: bank feeds, bank rules, multi-currency setup, and monthly reconciliation. Be ready to describe a real setup you've managed.

-Experience with ecommerce/multi-channel businesses, ideally with exposure to platforms like Shopify, PayPal, or similar payment processors, and comfort with multi-currency transactions.

-Real understanding of P&L construction beyond the software — you can explain concepts like weighted averages, margin by product line, or CAC/AOV in your own words, not just recite the terms.

-Fluent English, written and verbal — you'll communicate numbers and flags clearly, not just deliver spreadsheets.

-Daily availability, 7 days/week, structured around roughly 1 hour/day with flexibility on exact timing (your own time zone), plus 1-2 longer weekly sessions for deeper reconciliation work. Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working?

-Obsessive precision. This is a business where a wrongly categorized expense or a missed reconciliation isn't a small thing — it compounds. Mediocrity is not allowed on this team.

-Comfortable working with a lean, mostly-automated setup — this isn't a role drowning in manual invoice processing; it's a role that requires judgment on the few things that actually need hands-on attention.



What We Offer:

-A clearly defined, lean accounting structure already mapped out (bank rules, integrations, and processes) — you're not building chaos into order, you're maintaining and improving an already-sensible system.

-A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

-Real potential for the role to grow in scope as the business scales across multiple entities and revenue streams, with performance-based rate increases.

-Direct visibility into how the business actually runs financially — this isn't a role kept in the dark about the bigger picture.



To Apply: Tell us briefly about your experience with Xero and with ecommerce/multi-channel businesses. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short follow-up call or recorded response to a P&L scenario before moving forward.

* Ability to work aligned with New York time zone.

* Short-form video examples (Reels/Shorts/TikToks) aligned with current trends.

* Any case studies or breakdowns of how you improved a channel.



What We Offer

* Work with a sharp, global creative and operations team.

* Direct line of sight from your work to client revenue and impact.

* Access to systems, training, and playbooks on cutting-edge content and monetization.



If you want a role where you’re judged by output and growth, not meetings and politics, this is it.

title: WordPress & E-commerce Manager – Graphic Design + Store Growth
description:
WordPress & E-commerce Manager / Graphic Designer Wanted



We’re looking for a reliable, proactive, and professional WordPress & E-commerce Manager who also has strong graphic design skills.



Our company sells online through platforms such as Shopee, Lazada, eBay, and our own WordPress/WooCommerce store. We are growing and want someone who can take responsibility for our website, improve the store, and help us generate more orders.



This is not only a graphic design position. We need someone who understands e-commerce, WordPress, WooCommerce, store management, and online marketing.



What You’ll Do



* Manage and maintain our WordPress / WooCommerce store

* Upload and update products, prices, descriptions, images, and promotions

* Improve product pages and the overall customer experience

* Make basic website design and layout changes when necessary

* Fix basic WordPress problems and make sure the website works properly

* Look for ways to increase conversions and generate more orders

* Check website performance and identify areas that can be improved

* Monitor and verify Google Ads, tracking, conversions, and related website integrations

* Create professional graphics for products, promotions, advertisements, and social media

* Create content for Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Shopee, Lazada, eBay, and other platforms

* Follow our branding while bringing new ideas to the business

* Work independently, stay organized, and respect deadlines



What We Need



You should be professional and confident with WordPress and WooCommerce.



You should also have:



* Strong Photoshop skills

* Good graphic design skills

* Experience managing an e-commerce website

* Experience with WordPress and WooCommerce

* Basic knowledge of Google Ads and conversion tracking

* Good understanding of online stores and how to improve sales

* A good eye for layout, colors, details, and visual impact

* Ability to work independently and solve problems

* Strong attention to detail

* A serious and responsible attitude

* Willingness to learn, improve, and grow with the company



We are looking for someone who doesn’t simply wait for instructions. We want someone who can notice problems, suggest improvements, and help us grow the store.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



“WordPress E-commerce Master”



Then send only:



1. Direct links to WordPress / e-commerce stores you have personally managed only web site selling product . 

2. One direct link to your best graphic design work



For the store links, briefly tell us what you were responsible for.



Accepted portfolio links include:



* Behance

* Instagram

* Your public portfolio website

* Live websites/stores you have managed



Do not send Google Drive folders, private links, or file attachments.



No long introduction is necessary.



Your work and the stores you have managed will speak for themselves.



After 6 months of strong performance, reliability, and dedication, salary negotiation will be possible, with real opportunities to take more responsibility and grow inside our e-commerce team.

title: Technical Ecommerce Operator (VA) — Shopify, Meta Ads, Gorgias, AI
description:
We run a portfolio of fast-scaling ecommerce (DTC) brands doing 7–8 figures a month. We're hiring a sharp, TECHNICAL operator who already knows the game and can run the day-to-day across our systems — someone who moves things forward without being hand-held.



This is NOT an entry-level, data-entry VA role. You'll be inside the tools that keep real brands running.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Shopify store operations — products, variants, collections, inventory, orders, basic theme & landing-page edits

• Order fulfillment & supplier coordination — processing orders, tracking, dropshipping/3PL, requesting samples & quotes from suppliers

• Customer service in Gorgias — tickets, macros, WhatsApp &
, refunds, returns, exchanges, workflows

• Payments & disputes — handling refunds and chargebacks/disputes (Stripe / PayPal)

• Meta Ads Manager — navigating, launching, duplicating, day-to-day campaign management

• Product research — finding winning products, competitor & market research

• AI tools — fluent DAILY use of Claude & ChatGPT to work faster and build automations

• All the technical "get-it-done" work across sheets, trackers and internal systems



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ECOMMERCE KNOW-HOW YOU MUST HAVE

• Deep, hands-on Shopify fluency (not "I watched a tutorial")

• You understand the core metrics — ROAS, CPA, AOV, break-even — and can read whether something is actually working

• Meta Pixel / conversion tracking basics

• Landing-page / product-page building (GemPages, Replo, PageFly, Zipify or similar)

• Real customer-service judgment in an ecommerce context (WISMO, refunds, order issues)

• Comfort with suppliers and sourcing communication



BIG PLUS

•
/SMS marketing (Klaviyo) — flows & campaigns

• Reviews & UGC apps (Loox, 
, Yotpo)

• Experience with creative testing / ad-library research tools



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE

• Real, hands-on experience working with ecommerce / DTC brands — not theory

• Proven comfort in Shopify, Gorgias and Meta Ads Manager

• Strong English and a same-day response habit

• The ability to keep pace in a fast, high-standard environment



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⛔ READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

You are stepping into work with serious ecommerce brands doing 7–8 FIGURES A MONTH. The pace is high and the standard is higher. If you cannot operate at that level — please do NOT apply. We are not training anyone from zero. We want someone who already knows how this world works and wants to level up inside it.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHO WE WANT

• Open, hungry and driven to grow and succeed

• Proactive — you spot what repeats and systemize/fix it without being told

• Reliable, daily, full ownership of your tasks



WHAT YOU GET

• A long-term seat inside a growing, high-performing operation

• Real growth: more responsibility and strong pay as you prove yourself and invest in the work

• Direct work with the founders and a modern, AI-first workflow



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TO APPLY, SEND

1. A short note on your ecommerce experience — which brands/stores, and what you actually did

2. The exact tools you've used (Shopify? Gorgias? Meta Ads Manager? Klaviyo? Claude/ChatGPT?)

3. Your availability and rate expectation

4. Start your message with the word "SCALE" so we know you read this in full



Serious applicants only. If you've read all of this and you KNOW you can keep up — we want to hear from you.

title: Investment Analyst (LMM M&A) - FMVA, hourly, 40 hrs/week CT partial overlap
description:
Investment Analyst — Lower-Middle-Market M&A



Web LLC is a buy-side and sell-side advisory firm focused on lower-middle-market businesses. We are seeking an Investment Analyst to support transaction underwriting, deal sizing, valuation, quality-of-earnings analysis, and cash proof.



Ideal candidate



Available 40 hours per week, with overlap during U.S. Central Time



FMVA certified, currently pursuing the FMVA, or able to demonstrate equivalent financial-modeling experience



Proficient in three-statement modeling, DCF analysis, comparable-company analysis, and lower-middle-market valuation



Experienced with—or able to clearly explain—deal underwriting, quality of earnings, and cash proof



Bookkeeping-only experience will not qualify for this role.



How to apply



Record one 10–15 minute Loom video with your camera on. Share your screen and walk us through an example model you built, such as a three-statement model, DCF, or lower-middle-market valuation.



Please do not use a live or confidential client file.



Your Loom should cover:



Your desired hourly rate, shown handwritten on camera



How you size and underwrite a transaction



Your approach to quality of earnings or cash proof



How you value a lower-middle-market business using DCF and comparable-company analysis



Compensation is hourly and commensurate with experience.



Apply through the form only and paste your Loom URL into your submission. Applications submitted without the form and Loom will not receive a response.
