title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Video Creator & Virtual Assistant
description:
AI TikTok Shop Affiliate Video Creator & Virtual Assistant — salary is negotiable 



I’m seeking a creative, dependable virtual assistant to produce polished TikTok Shop affiliate videos using product links, listing photos, seller-provided media and AI-powered tools.



No physical products will be shipped. You must be comfortable creating original, professional product videos entirely from the digital information and assets provided. This role is ideal for someone who understands short-form content, can develop compelling product angles and takes pride in delivering accurate, engaging work.



This is a part-time, long-term opportunity with flexible scheduling and the potential to grow into additional hours, performance bonuses and higher compensation as your quality, efficiency, reliability and results are demonstrated.



What You Will Do



* Research each product and its target customer

* Study current TikTok trends and successful product-video structures

* Develop original video concepts and selling angles

* Write attention-grabbing hooks, scripts and calls to action

* Create original AI-generated product scenes and UGC-style content

* Turn product photos and approved seller assets into engaging videos

* Generate natural-sounding AI voiceovers when needed

* Edit complete 10–30 second vertical videos

* Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects and transitions

* Create multiple variations for each product using different hooks

* Deliver finished videos without watermarks

* Organize completed videos, scripts and product links in Google Drive

* Track completed assignments in Google Sheets

* Make reasonable revisions when requested



Approved Content Sources



You may use:



* Product links and information I provide

* Product photos and videos approved for affiliate use

* Seller-provided media

* Licensed stock footage

* AI-generated footage

* Original graphics, scripts, voiceovers and editing



You may not download and repost another creator’s video, remove watermarks or present someone else’s footage as original work.



Video Requirements



* Approximately 10–30 seconds

* Vertical 9:16 format

* Strong hook during the first one to two seconds

* Clear product benefit or problem-and-solution angle

* Engaging visual movement

* Easy-to-read captions

* Natural-sounding voiceover when included

* Clear call to action

* No editing-platform watermarks

* Content must feel native to TikTok—not like a traditional commercial



Because you will not physically possess the products, videos must not falsely claim personal ownership or firsthand experience. Do not use statements such as “I bought this,” “I use this every day” or “This worked for me” unless specifically supported and approved.



Preferred Tools



Experience with several of the following is preferred:



* CapCut

* Canva

* TopView AI

* Creatify

* HeyGen

* Kling

* Runway

* ElevenLabs

* ChatGPT or similar scriptwriting tools

* Google Drive and Google Sheets



You do not need to use every tool, but you must be able to produce a complete, polished video from product information and digital assets.



Requirements



* Experience creating TikTok, Reels, Shorts, AI UGC or product videos

* Strong CapCut or short-form video-editing skills

* Understanding of hooks, viewer retention and calls to action

* Ability to create original content without a physical product

* Strong written English

* Creative thinking and attention to detail

* Reliable internet access

* Responsive communication

* Ability to meet deadlines and follow instructions

* Willingness to learn which video styles produce the most clicks and sales



TikTok Shop and affiliate-marketing experience is preferred, but talented beginners with strong samples are welcome.



Compensation and Schedule



* Starting rate: NEGOTIATED $1.50 - $3.00 per hour 

* Approximately 10–20 hours per week initially

* Flexible working schedule with agreed deadlines

* Paid trial assignment

* Performance bonuses may be available for videos that generate strong views, clicks or sales

* Opportunity to receive additional hours and pay increases based on demonstrated performance



The negotiated starting rate reflects the initial stage of the role and is intended to provide an opportunity to demonstrate your skills in a real production workflow. Compensation may increase as you consistently deliver high-quality, original, compliant videos efficiently and reliably. Any increases or bonuses will be based on factors such as content quality, turnaround time, accuracy, communication, consistency and measurable performance where applicable.



This is a high-volume content position. However, quality, originality and compliance are more important than submitting rushed or repetitive videos.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your name and location

2. A short introduction

3. Links to three short-form videos you created and edited

4. Examples of AI UGC or product videos created without possessing the product

5. A list of the AI and editing tools you use

6. Your weekly availability

7. Your experience with TikTok Shop or affiliate marketing

8. How many polished 10–30 second videos you can realistically complete per hour

9. Your normal turnaround time

10. Confirmation that you can provide the scripts, editable project files and completed videos



Begin your application with “PURPLE AI VIDEO” so I know you read the entire posting.



Shortlisted applicants will complete one small paid test video using the same product link and digital assets. The test will evaluate originality, hook strength, editing, accuracy, communication and ability to follow instructions.



I’m looking for someone creative, honest, dependable and interested in building a long-term working relationship with clear opportunities for growth based on performance.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php80,000.00 per month

Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

title: Social Media Scout | $3-$5/hr + Bonuses & Residual Earnings
description:
THIS IS NOT A TYPICAL SOCIAL MEDIA JOB.



Are you the kind of person who can find almost anything online?



Do you know how to find real conversations happening in
 Groups, Reddit, 
, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Quora, or X?



More importantly, can you recognize when someone is actively looking for help, join the conversation naturally, and make a useful recommendation without sounding like an advertisement?



TaskNuts is hiring Social Media Scouts.



TaskNuts is a U.S.-based home services marketplace that helps homeowners get repairs and maintenance handled while connecting contractors with real jobs.



We are building a human-powered organic customer acquisition team.



We are NOT looking for someone to create content calendars, schedule posts, grow followers, or spam links.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Your job is to find existing online conversations where there is already real intent.



For example:



A homeowner posts:



"Can anyone recommend a reliable handyman? I have several small repairs I need done."



A person asks:



"Does anyone know a plumber who will actually show up?"



A contractor says:



"I'm tired of paying for leads that never turn into jobs."



Your job is to find these conversations, determine whether TaskNuts is genuinely relevant, and participate naturally and helpfully.



You'll primarily be searching for U.S. homeowners who need home repair, maintenance, or improvement services. You may also recruit contractors when TaskNuts is actively seeking additional contractors in a particular market or trade.



YOU DON'T NEED TO BE GREAT AT EVERY PLATFORM



We actually prefer specialists.



Maybe you know
 Groups extremely well.



Maybe Reddit is your world.



Maybe you're great at finding communities on 
.



Maybe you understand TikTok or YouTube search and comments better than everyone else.



We are hiring multiple Scouts with different strengths.



Tell us which platform you are exceptionally good at.



PAY



Base Pay: $3 USD/hour



We are open to starting at approximately 10–20 hours per week during the initial training/performance period.



Scouts who demonstrate strong performance can quickly move to up to 40 hours per week.



But the hourly rate is only one part of the compensation.



You can also earn performance bonuses and ongoing residual bonuses from qualified homeowners and contractors you bring to TaskNuts.



HOMEOWNER BONUSES



$2 for each qualified homeowner signup with a verified property



$20 when that homeowner completes their first TaskNuts job within 60 days



$10 if their first completed job occurs after 60 days



$10 for each subsequent completed job



CONTRACTOR BONUSES



When contractor recruitment is open for the applicable market/trade:



$2 for each qualified contractor signup



$30 when that contractor completes their first TaskNuts job



$2 for each subsequent completed job



THE RESIDUAL OPPORTUNITY



This is what makes the Scout Program different.



Qualified homeowners and contractors you acquire remain attributed to your Scout account while you remain eligible under the TaskNuts Scout Program.



If a homeowner you recruited returns months later and completes another job, that activity can generate another bonus for you.



If you recruit a great contractor who goes on to complete many TaskNuts jobs, their future completed jobs can continue generating bonuses for you.



The goal is to build a growing book of TaskNuts users, not simply work hours.



Performance and residual earnings are not guaranteed and are subject to TaskNuts Scout Program qualification rules and continued good standing.



YOUR SCOUT PORTAL



Every Scout receives their own TaskNuts Scout Portal and unique referral links.



You'll be able to see:



Homeowners you've acquired

Contractors you've acquired

Qualified signups

Completed-job activity

Bonuses and residuals you've earned

Your referral links

TaskNuts Share Center resources



We handle the attribution and tracking so you can focus on finding opportunities.



WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



We do not want spam.



No fake testimonials.



No pretending to be a TaskNuts customer.



No fake U.S. identities.



No mass copy-and-paste comments.



No indiscriminate link dropping.



No bots or automated mass posting.



No circumventing
 Group, subreddit, 
 server, or other community rules.



We want Scouts who understand how to become useful participants in online communities.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



Strong written English

A good understanding of natural U.S. online conversation

Excellent internet research skills

Resourcefulness

Good judgment

An understanding of online communities

The ability to recognize real buying intent

The ability to work independently

A performance-driven mindset



Experience with social media, lead generation, community management, online research, or customer acquisition is helpful, but resourcefulness matters more to us than your previous job title.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words:



I FOUND THE CONVERSATION



Then answer these 5 questions:



1. Rank these platforms from strongest to weakest for you:



, Reddit, 
, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Quora, X.



Which ONE are you exceptionally good at, and why?



2. A homeowner in a U.S.
 group posts:



"Can anyone recommend a reliable handyman? I have several small repairs."



Write EXACTLY what you would reply if you wanted to naturally introduce TaskNuts.



3. You are assigned St. Louis, Missouri and need to find homeowners actively looking for repair help. Describe 3 specific ways you would find these conversations using your strongest platform.



4. What accounts would you actually use to perform this work? Tell us whether they are existing personal/professional accounts, approximately how established they are, and whether you currently participate in U.S.-focused communities.



Do not create fake U.S. identities or accounts for this application.



5. You work 15 hours during your first week but generate zero qualified signups. What would you analyze, change, or test during week two?



We are looking to hire quickly and want Scouts interested in building a long-term position and a growing book of residual earnings with TaskNuts.

title: Social Media Content Creator + Assistant — Beauty Brand
description:
Social Media Content Creator + Assistant — Beauty Brand



Remote | Philippines | Flexible Hours | Long-Term Opportunity



We’re a growing US-based e-commerce beauty brand looking for a female social media manager that is creative and detail-oriented to join our growing team.



If you love beauty, spend a lot of time on Instagram/TikTok, have an eye for beautiful content, and know how to turn raw footage into engaging Reels — we’d love to hear from you!



Our aesthetic is **clean, feminine, chic, modern, and elevated.**



This role is focused on content creation, video editing, social media, and copywriting. We’re looking for someone who can bring creative ideas to the table — not just wait for instructions or create generic AI-generated content.



MUST-HAVE SKILLS



* Excellent written English and grammar

* Strong Reels/TikTok video editing, skills

* Proficient in CapCut or Edits app

* Strong eye for clean, feminine, elevated content

* Ability to write engaging hooks, captions, and social copy

* Understands pacing, text-on-screen, B-roll, trending audio, and short-form storytelling

* Keeps up with Instagram/TikTok trends and knows how to adapt them for a brand

* Creative and able to come up with **original content ideas**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow directions

* Takes feedback well and implements changes quickly

* Resourceful and able to problem-solve independently

* Reliable communicator who meets deadlines

* Stable internet + backup internet connection



**BONUS SKILLS:** Experience with beauty, fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce, UGC, influencer marketing, Shopify, or
 marketing.



A NOTE ABOUT AI



We’re completely fine with using AI as a tool for brainstorming and efficiency, but we are not looking for generic AI-generated content.



Your work should feel creative, thoughtful, current, and specific to our brand. We value human creativity, taste, and good judgment.



 WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Edit content: carousels, Reels/TikToks from raw footage

* Create hooks, captions, text overlays, and content concepts

* Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content

*

* Research beauty and social media trends

* Create simple graphics, carousels, and Stories

* Help plan and maintain our content calendar

* Source and organize UGC

* Help find and communicate with creators/influencers

* Assist with gifting and affiliate partnerships

* Schedule and publish social content

* Engage with our audience and relevant accounts

* Track what’s performing and suggest ways we can improve

* Regularly bring new content ideas to the team



We want someone who can look at our brand and think:



"Here’s what we should post next.”



WHO YOU ARE



You’re creative, organized, dependable, and genuinely interested in social media.



You notice the little things. You know why one Reel catches your attention while another gets skipped. You’re comfortable sharing ideas, learning from feedback, and figuring things out without needing step-by-step instructions every time.



Most importantly, you care about the quality of your work and want to grow with a brand long-term.



HOURS



This is a 100% remote position with flexible hours. You can primarily work within your own time zone, but reliable communication and meeting deadlines are important.



We care more about quality, productivity, and result than having you online during every working hour.



This position will begin with a paid trial/probationary period to make sure we’re a great fit for each other.



Compensation will depend on experience and skill level, with plenty of room to grow based on performance.



BENEFITS + PERKS



**After 6 months of full-time employment:**



* 10 days paid time off

* A gift on your birthday each year 

* End-of-year performance bonus

* Frequent raises based on skill + performance

* Additional bonuses for exceptional work

* Flexible working hours

* 100% remote work

* Opportunities to grow into a larger role as the company grows



 HOW TO APPLY



**Please follow ALL instructions below to be considered.**



Start your application with **“ELORA Content Creator”** and include:



**1. Short Introduction**

Tell us about yourself, your social media/content experience, and why this role interests you.



**2. Portfolio**

Send examples of Reels/TikToks, social content, designs, or captions you’ve personally created. Beauty, fashion, or lifestyle work is a plus.



**3. Content Test**

Visit 
 and choose ONE existing Reel/post you think could be improved. Tell us:



* What you would change and why

* A better hook/text-on-screen

* A new caption



**4. Give us 3 content ideas  you would create for our brand. Include a hook + short concept for each.



**5. Video Editing Samples**

Send 1–3 short-form videos you personally edited.



**6. Trend Research**

Show us ONE current Instagram/TikTok trend you think would work for a lash brand and briefly tell us how you would use it.



Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be considered.

 

If you love beauty content, have a strong creative eye, and want to grow alongside an emerging beauty brand, we’d love to meet you!

title: Experienced Etsy + Printify Listing Specialist – $300 Project
description:
I am launching a new Etsy print-on-demand store and am hiring 2 experienced Etsy + Printify Listing Specialists to help build the shop.



Each person will be responsible for creating 75 complete, professional, SEO-optimized Etsy listings within 14 days.



IMPORTANT — EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



This position is for experienced Etsy + Printify specialists only.



Because of the fast 14-day project timeline, I will not have time to train someone on Etsy, Printify, POD, Etsy SEO, keyword research, or listing creation.



You must already know how to independently create a complete, professional Etsy listing from start to finish using Printify.



Please do not apply if you are new to Etsy, Printify, or print-on-demand.



I will provide shop-specific instructions and expectations, but I am looking for someone who can begin working immediately without needing training on the platforms or basic listing procedures.



COMPENSATION



$300 USD Fixed Project



75 approved listings × $4 per listing = $300



This is a short-term project with the possibility of additional work for excellent performance.



Selected applicants will begin with a paid 3-listing test ($12) before receiving the full assignment.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be provided with the products and general shop instructions.



For each assigned product, you will:



Create and set up the product in Printify

Configure correct sizes, colors and variants

Create or select attractive, professional product mockups

Prepare and publish the product to Etsy

Conduct Etsy keyword and competitor research

Write an SEO-optimized Etsy title

Write a clear, persuasive, SEO-friendly description

Create all 13 relevant Etsy tags

Select appropriate Etsy categories and attributes

Set up clear personalization instructions when applicable

Properly organize listing photos

Follow provided pricing instructions

Check spelling, grammar and product information

Perform final quality control before submitting the listing for approval

SEO EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



This is not simply a product-uploading position.



You must already understand Etsy SEO and be able to make intelligent decisions about:



Buyer search terms

Long-tail keywords

Etsy titles

Etsy tags

Categories

Attributes

Search intent

Personalized product keywords

Competitor and keyword research



Do not simply copy the same title, tags and description from one listing to another.



Each listing should be individually optimized for the specific product and target customer.



PRODUCT TYPE



The store primarily sells personalized Printify products.



Customers will be able to add their own words, quotes, sayings, phrases, messages and other personalized text to products.



Experience creating listings for personalized or customizable Etsy products is strongly preferred.



You should already understand how to make the personalization process simple and clear for customers.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must already have hands-on experience with:



Etsy listing creation

Printify

Print-on-demand products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Etsy titles, tags, categories and attributes

Personalized/custom products

Product mockups

Canva or similar tools

Strong written English



This is NOT a beginner or training position.



I need someone who can receive instructions, understand the project requirements, and immediately begin producing professional listings independently.



WORKLOAD



75 completed and approved listings



14-day deadline



This averages approximately 5–6 completed listings per day.



The deadline is firm.



Please apply only if you have enough availability to complete the project on time without sacrificing quality.



QUALITY REQUIREMENTS



A listing will be considered complete when it is accurate, polished, customer-ready and meets the project instructions.



Listings should include:



Strong Etsy SEO

Relevant keyword research

Professional mockups

Accurate product information

Correct variants

Clear personalization instructions

Proper categories and attributes

All 13 relevant tags

Professional description

Correct spelling and grammar

Final quality check



Rushed, incomplete, duplicated or poorly optimized listings will require correction before approval.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will complete:



3 paid Etsy + Printify listings



Payment: $12 USD



The test will evaluate:



SEO and keyword research

Title quality

Tags

Description

Mockups

Accuracy

Attention to detail

Printify setup

Personalization setup

Overall Etsy listing quality



The test is intended to verify your existing skills, not to train you.



Applicants who demonstrate the required experience may then receive the remaining listings for the full project.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



How many Etsy listings have you personally created?

How many years or months have you worked with Etsy?

How much hands-on experience do you have with Printify?

Have you created Etsy listings for personalized/custom products?

Please provide examples of Etsy listings you personally created.

What tools do you use for Etsy keyword research?

What tools do you use for product mockups?

Briefly explain how you research keywords for a new Etsy product.

Approximately how long does it take you to create one complete Etsy + Printify listing?

Can you independently create listings without Etsy or Printify training?

Can you consistently complete 5–6 quality listings per day?

Can you complete 75 listings within 14 days?

Do you agree to the $300 project rate based on 75 completed and approved listings at $4 each?

Are you willing to complete the 3-listing paid test first?



To show that you read the entire posting, begin your application with:



QUOTE DIVA



Applications that do not include this phrase or do not demonstrate previous Etsy + Printify experience will not be considered.



PROJECT DETAILS



Position: Experienced Etsy + Printify Listing Specialist

Type: Short-Term Project

Project Length: 2 Weeks

Listings Per VA: 75

Total Pay Per VA: $300 USD

Rate: $4 per completed and approved listing

Paid Test: 3 listings / $12

Number of People Being Hired: 2

Training: None — prior experience required



Excellent work may lead to additional listing projects and ongoing Etsy store support.

title: Performance Creative Strategist & Meta Ads Operator
description:
Performance Creative Strategist & Meta Ads Operator



Full-Time Remote

$800/month + Uncapped Performance Bonuses



ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for a highly creative, performance-driven person to take ownership of the creative pipeline for a profitable digital product advertised primarily through Meta Ads.



This is NOT a traditional Media Buyer position.



Your main objective is simple:



Find and create winning ads — and produce them at scale.



We already have a product that converts and profitable Meta campaigns.



Our biggest bottleneck is creative volume.



We want to go from testing a handful of ads to continuously testing new concepts, angles, hooks and formats every day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will own the creative process from research to launch:



* Research competitors daily using Meta Ad Library and other sources

* Identify winning advertising concepts, formats, hooks and angles

* Understand WHY competitor ads work instead of simply copying them

* Develop new advertising angles for our product

* Create video ads

* Create static/image ads

* Create UGC-style and native-looking ads

* Use AI image/video tools to dramatically increase creative output

* Write hooks, headlines and ad copy

* Create multiple variations of promising concepts

* Upload and launch creatives directly inside Meta Ads Manager

* Analyze CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and creative-level performance

* Identify winning creatives

* Iterate aggressively on winners

* Kill weak ideas and continuously replace them with new tests



EXPECTED CREATIVE OUTPUT



We operate with a high-volume testing philosophy.



You should be capable of producing approximately 5–10 new ad variations per working day.



This does NOT mean inventing 10 completely new concepts every day.



For example:



3 new concepts

x 3 different hooks/variations

= 9 ads to test



Speed and iteration are extremely important.



We would rather test 100 good ideas quickly than spend one week making one "perfect" advertisement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should understand:



* Meta Ads

* Direct-response advertising

* Creative testing

* Hooks

* Marketing angles

* Customer psychology

* UGC advertising

* Video editing

* Static ads

* Meta Ad Library research

* CTR / CPC / CPA / ROAS

* Creative iteration



Experience with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop or similar is useful.



Experience using AI tools for image generation, video generation, voice generation or UGC production is a major advantage.



We care about performance, not beautiful branding.



An ugly ad generating a 3.0 ROAS is more valuable to us than a beautiful ad generating a 0.8 ROAS.



COMPENSATION



Base salary: $800 USD/month



PLUS performance bonuses.



There is no fixed ceiling on your compensation.



Examples of monthly scaling bonuses:



$10,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $200 bonus



$20,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $400 bonus



$30,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $600 bonus



$50,000+ ad spend while maintaining 1.50+ ROAS = $1,000 bonus



Exceptional performance can result in additional bonuses.



WINNING CREATIVE BONUS



You can also receive bonuses for individual winning concepts.



A creative that reaches meaningful spend while remaining profitable can qualify for an additional performance bonus.



The better the creatives perform and the more we are able to scale, the more you earn.



Our goal is to create a situation where a great Creative Strategist can earn significantly more than the $800 base salary.



IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for:



* A generic Social Media Manager

* Someone focused on organic Instagram content

* Someone who only knows graphic design

* Someone who needs detailed instructions for every creative

* Someone who creates beautiful videos but doesn't understand performance marketing



We ARE looking for someone who thinks:



Research → Hypothesis → Creative → Test → Data → Iteration → Scale



You will have significant creative freedom.



If you see an interesting advertising format from another industry, test it.



If you see a competitor doing something interesting, understand why it works and adapt the principle.



If one of our ads starts performing extremely well, create new iterations of it.



We want someone obsessed with finding the next winning creative.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Examples of Meta ads you personally created.

2. Screenshots of Ads Manager results associated with your creatives, if available.

3. Your experience with Meta Ads.

4. The AI tools you currently use for creative production.

5. Your experience with video editing.

6. Your experience researching competitors and Meta Ad Library.



Finally, choose one advertisement from your portfolio and explain:



* Why you believe it performed well

* What its main hook/angle was

* What 3 variations you would test next



Applications without examples of previous advertising work will not be considered.

We are a UK-based digital marketing agency helping window and door installers, roofers and other home-improvement companies generate more local homeowner enquiries.



We are looking for a confident and reliable cold caller to contact UK home-improvement business owners and book qualified strategy calls for our team.



This is genuine cold calling. The businesses have not requested a call and may not be familiar with our agency. You must be comfortable starting conversations, handling rejection and speaking naturally without sounding as though you are reading from a script.



This is primarily an appointment-setting role, not a hard-closing sales position.



What You’ll Do

- Make outbound cold calls to UK window and door companies and other selected home-improvement businesses

- Ask for the owner or relevant decision-maker

- Introduce our lead-generation service using the script and talking points provided

- Ask qualifying questions and book short strategy calls with interested prospects

- Handle common objections calmly and professionally

- Log every call outcome immediately in our spreadsheet or CRM

- Arrange callbacks and complete agreed follow-ups

- Provide a short end-of-day report covering calls, conversations, appointments and blockers

- Follow up promptly with inbound leads if and when they are assigned



What We Provide

- A pre-built prospect list

- UK calling software and business number

- Cold-calling script

- Objection-handling guide

- Regular feedback and support



You will not be expected to source your own leads or use your personal telephone number.



Two-Week Trial Expectations

During the paid trial, we expect approximately:

- 50–55 call attempts daily

- 500–550 call attempts across two weeks

- Accurate logging of every outcome

- Consistent follow-up on callbacks

- Genuine qualified appointments, not unconfirmed or unsuitable bookings



Performance will be assessed based on reliability, call quality, decision-maker conversations, accurate reporting and qualified appointments, not call volume alone.



What We’re Looking For

- Excellent spoken English that is clear and easy for UK business owners to understand

- Previous cold-calling, telemarketing, appointment-setting or BPO experience

- B2B calling experience is strongly preferred

- Confident and conversational telephone manner

- Ability to follow a script without sounding robotic

- Reliable internet connection, good-quality headset and quiet working environment

- Comfortable using computer-based calling software, spreadsheets and simple CRM tools

- Able to work consistently during the agreed UK-hours shift



Compensation and Progression

- Starting rate: $6 USD per hour

- 20 hours per week during the initial paid trial

- Weekly payment through Upwork

- $40 USD commission for every closed client generated from an appointment you book

- Long-term work available for consistent performers

- Opportunity for increased hours and a higher hourly rate based on performance



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

- Attach a 60 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are suitable for the role.

- State your availability in UK time.

- Briefly describe your cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

Applications without a voice recording or UK-time availability will not be considered.

title: Product Research & Development Associate
description:
# Product Research & Development Associate



**Full-time | Remote | Product Department**



We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating across the USA, UK and EU, with a growing portfolio of health and children's products.



We are looking for a highly **curious, analytical and commercially minded** person to identify the next generation of products for our business.



Your job is to find opportunities, investigate them deeply and determine **whether they are actually worth pursuing**.



### What You Will Do



**Product & Market Research**



* Research new product opportunities within our niches

* Identify trends, customer needs and market gaps

* Find product variations, line extensions and improvements

* Research competitors, pricing, positioning and features

* Analyse customer reviews to understand what people love, dislike and want improved



**Validate Product Opportunities**



Before we invest time and money developing a product, you will help determine:



* Is there genuine demand?

* What problem does it solve?

* Who is the target customer?

* What are customers currently buying?

* What are competitors failing to solve?

* What could we do differently?

* How competitive is the market?

* What price could we sell at?

* What are likely product costs and margins?

* Is this opportunity commercially worthwhile?



We don't want research for the sake of research.



We want to know: **“Should we make this product — and why?”**



### Customer Insight



You will also become responsible for systematically learning from our existing customers.



You will:



* Collect and analyse customer reviews and complaints

* Identify recurring product problems and requested features

* Categorise feedback and identify patterns

* Track changes in customer feedback

* Turn customer insights into product improvement recommendations



You will pass these insights to our **China-based Product Development Specialist**, who will investigate and solve the physical product issues.



### Product Development & Pipeline



Once a product is approved, you will continue supporting development with:



* Customer research

* Competitor analysis

* Target customer requirements

* Feature recommendations

* Pricing and positioning research

* Market trends

* Key problems the product must solve



You will also maintain our **product opportunity pipeline**, research documents, customer feedback and project information, ensuring important insights and decisions don't get lost.



### We Are Looking For Someone Who



* Is naturally curious and constantly asks **“why?”**

* Has excellent research, analytical and critical-thinking skills

* Thinks commercially rather than simply finding “interesting” products

* Can distinguish a genuinely attractive opportunity from a bad one

* Is comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and data

* Can turn large amounts of customer feedback into clear insights

* Has excellent written communication and organisation skills

* Is proactive and takes ownership

* Has strong attention to detail



Experience in **e-commerce, Amazon, product research, market research, product management or consumer products** is strongly preferred.



Experience with Amazon research tools, Google Trends, competitor intelligence tools and spreadsheets is an advantage.



### The Type of Person We Want



We are **not looking for someone who simply searches Amazon and produces product lists.**



If you see a product with 10,000 reviews, we want you asking:



**Why is it selling? Who is buying it? What are customers complaining about? What are competitors failing to solve? Could we build something meaningfully better? Would customers pay enough for it to be profitable?**



You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and telling us when an idea **isn't good enough to pursue**.



We are a remote female team that moves quickly, takes work seriously and invests in training and development. **We do not do graveyard hours.**



**Full-time | Competitive salary based on experience**



### To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. 2 examples of product research you personally completed and the conclusions you reached

3. One product opportunity you identified and why it was commercially attractive

4. One customer problem/insight you identified from reviews and what action you recommended

5. One product you think is currently poorly designed or underserved and how you would improve it

This starts as an onboarding and access role, but it will grow. For the right person, there's room to take on broader systems and operations responsibilities over time. We'd rather find someone we can invest in than fill a seat.

I'm looking for a sharp, highly organized, and exceptionally well-spoken Virtual Assistant / Executive Assistant to take the day-to-day administrative load off my plate so I can focus on clinical leadership, growth, and strategy.

s, and produce polished, executive-level work product with minimal hand-holding.

Calendar management — Own my calendar across multiple businesses, proactively resolve conflicts, block focus time, and keep everything organized so I'm never double-booked or caught off guard.

 support — Help triage and organize my Gmail inbox, flag what's urgent, and draft routine responses for my review.

Making calls on my behalf — Occasionally call or
 doctors' offices, vendors, or business contacts to schedule or confirm appointments — this requires a confident, professional, native-level phone manner.

Excellent English communication skills — written AND spoken. This is the single most important requirement. You'll be
ing and speaking with doctors' offices, vendors, and business contacts on my behalf, so you need to sound polished, professional, and easily understood by a US-based audience (near-native fluency, clear pronunciation, minimal accent).

Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant or Executive Assistant supporting a US-based executive or business owner.

Strong hands-on experience with Google Workspace — Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, and especially Google Slides / PowerPoint deck design.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle priorities across multiple businesses without dropping the ball.

We are looking for a long-term team member who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates confidently over voice and video calls, and wants to grow alongside an expanding company by building and refining operational processes.

Transaction Management: Oversee all stages of buyer transactions, listings, and leases, tracking and driving critical deadlines (inspections, appraisals, financing contingencies, and settlement).



Voice & Video Communication: Act as a central point of contact. You will regularly hop on phone calls and Google Meets with U.S. agents, team leadership, clients, lenders, and title companies.



Documentation & Compliance: Review, prepare, and organize state-specific real estate contracts, disclosures, and closing documents with meticulous accuracy.



Process Building & Logistics: Help design, streamline, and implement backend systems and checklists to improve team efficiency. Maintain transaction calendars and closing schedules.



Database Maintenance: Update and maintain our CRM and transaction management platform daily to keep all deal statuses current.



Requirements



Real Estate Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience in U.S. real estate transaction coordination or administrative support (experience with MD, VA, or D.C. contracts is a major plus, but not required).



Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written English skills. Confident and comfortable speaking directly with U.S.-based clients, agents, and settlement partners via phone and Google Meet.



Work Ethic & Mindset: Self-starter attitude, high emotional intelligence under pressure, and impeccable attention to detail.



Tech Proficiency: Proficient with transaction platforms (DotLoop, SkySlope, Brokermint, DocuSign, Bright MLS), CRMs, and Google Workspace.



Home Office Setup: A quiet work environment, a reliable high-speed internet connection, a working headset/webcam, and backup power/internet solutions to ensure uninterrupted work.



Schedule, Pay & Growth



Working Hours: Full-Time, 40–50 hours weekly (paid for every hour worked). Works during U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours (Night Shift in the PH). Standard schedule is Monday–Friday, with occasional late shifts or Saturday work days required based on deal volume. PAID FOR EVERY HOUR WORKED! 



Location: 100% Remote (Work from Home, Philippines).



Training: We provide robust, hands-on training to get you up to speed on our specific systems and regional contracts.



Clear Compensation & Growth Path: Starting rate is $6.50 – $7.50 USD/hr (depending on U.S. real estate experience). title: Virtual Construction Administrative Assistant / Subcontractor Coordinator
description:
We are a U.S.-based construction company expanding our subcontracting operations in New Mexico and are looking for a reliable, organized Virtual Assistant to help manage the administrative side of the business.



This will be a long-term position for the right person. You will work directly with the owner and help keep projects, subcontractors, estimates, paperwork, and billing organized.



Responsibilities



* Find and contact subcontractors in New Mexico for different construction trades

* Maintain a database of subcontractors, contact information, pricing, licenses, and insurance

* Request quotes and follow up with subcontractors

* Help organize bids, estimates, scopes of work, and project documents

* Track projects from bidding through completion and invoicing

* Prepare and organize subcontractor agreements and work orders

* Track Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, licenses, and other compliance documents

* Help prepare invoices and track outstanding payments

* Organize receipts, expenses, purchase orders, and project costs

* Maintain Excel/Google Sheets project trackers

* Schedule subcontractors and follow up on project deadlines

* Make phone calls and send professional
s to subcontractors, vendors, and customers

* Research permits, contractors, vendors, materials, and construction-related information

* Keep Google Drive/project folders organized

* Provide the owner with a clear daily or weekly update of outstanding items



Ideal Candidate



You should be:



* Highly organized and dependable

* Comfortable making phone calls to U.S. companies

* Fluent or highly proficient in written and spoken English

* Good at following up with people without needing constant reminders

* Comfortable working independently

* Experienced with Excel and Google Sheets

* Able to write professional
s

* Comfortable learning construction terminology

* Detail-oriented with numbers and paperwork

* Able to handle multiple projects at the same time



Construction, general contracting, subcontractor management, estimating, bookkeeping, or project coordination experience is a major plus.



Experience working with U.S. construction companies is especially valuable.



Typical Tasks



One day you may be asked to find three licensed HVAC subcontractors in Albuquerque and request pricing.



Another day you may need to organize subcontractor quotes, update our project cost tracker, prepare an invoice, check which subcontractors are missing insurance documents, and follow up on outstanding bids.



The goal of this position is to take administrative work off the owner’s plate and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Hours



Initially, this position may start part-time with the opportunity to become full-time as our New Mexico operations grow.



Some working hours must overlap with Mountain Time in the United States so you can contact New Mexico subcontractors and vendors during normal business hours.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience working with construction companies or contractors

3. Your experience with Excel/Google Sheets

4. Whether you are comfortable making outbound phone calls to U.S. businesses

5. Your expected hourly rate

6. Your available working hours

7. The software/programs you have experience using



At the beginning of your application, write “NEW MEXICO” so we know you read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and can eventually become a key administrative person in our construction operation.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)
